rows.source_ko: 식품의약품안전처 (혁신행정담당관), 043-719-1454
rows.text_en: Ministry of Food and Drug Safety ( Innovation Administration Division ), 043-719-1454

rows.source_ko: 제1장 총칙
rows.text_en: Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 식품의약품안전처와 그 소속기관에 두는 보조기관ㆍ보좌기관의 직급 및 직급별 정원, 「정부조직법」 제2조제3항 및 제5항에 따라 기획조정관ㆍ국장ㆍ기획관ㆍ부장 밑에 두는 보조기관과 이에 상당하는 보좌기관의 설치 및 사무분장 등 「식품의약품안전처와 그 소속기관 직제」에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Organization of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety and Its Affiliated Agencies” and matters necessary for its implementation, such as the ranks and staffing quotas for auxiliary and advisory agencies established, the establishment of auxiliary agencies and equivalent advisory agencies placed under the Director of Planning and Coordination, Director General, Planning Officer, and Department Head pursuant to Article 2, Paragraphs 3 and 5 of the “Government Organization Act.”

rows.source_ko: 제2장 식품의약품안전처
rows.text_en: Chapter 2 Ministry of Food and Drug Safety

rows.source_ko: 제2조(차장) 차장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직 또는 연구직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다. <개정 2014. 2. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Deputy Minister) The Deputy Minister shall be appointed from among general or research officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of the position is Grade A. <Amended Feb. 20, 2014>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(대변인) 대변인은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Spokesperson) The Spokesperson shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제3조의2(디지털소통팀장) ① 처장 밑에 디지털소통팀장 1명을 둔다. <개정 2026. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 3-2 (Head of Digital Communication Team) ① One Head of Digital Communication Team shall be appointed under the Minister. <Amended Mar. 24, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 디지털소통팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ수의사무관ㆍ의료기술사무관ㆍ식품위생사무관ㆍ약무사무관ㆍ전산사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of the digital communication team shall be appointed from among the science and technology secretary, secretary, veterinary officer, medical technology officer, food hygiene officer, pharmaceutical officer, computer officer, or administrative officer.

rows.source_ko: ③ 디지털소통팀장은 다음 사항에 관하여 처장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Digital Communication Team Leader assists the Director in the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 주요 정책에 관한 디지털소통계획 수립 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and coordination of digital communication plans regarding major policies

rows.source_ko: 2. 처장 정책활동에 대한 디지털소통 지원
rows.text_en: 2. Support for digital communication regarding the Director's policy activities

rows.source_ko: 3. 디지털소통 채널 운영 및 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Operation and Management of Digital Communication Channels

rows.source_ko: 4. 디지털소통 콘텐츠 제작 및 주요 정책의 대국민 디지털소통 지원
rows.text_en: 4. Production of digital communication content and support for digital communication of major policies to the public

rows.source_ko: 5. 온라인을 활용한 처 내 홍보 활동의 점검ㆍ평가
rows.text_en: 5. Monitoring and Evaluation of Internal Promotional Activities Using Online Platforms

[This Article newly inserted Dec. 30, 2025]
[Title amended Mar. 24, 2026]
[Formerly Article 3-2 moved to Article 3-3 <Dec. 30, 2025>]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의3(글로벌수출전략담당관) 글로벌수출전략담당관은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3-3 (Global Export Strategy Officer) The Global Export Strategy Officer shall be appointed from among the Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Health Research Officer, or Industrial Research Officer.

[This Article newly inserted Sep. 23, 2025]
[Moved from Article 3-2 <Dec. 30, 2025>]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(기획조정관) ① 기획조정관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Director of Planning and Coordination) ① The Director of Planning and Coordination shall be appointed from among general civil servants, health research officers, or industrial research officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 기획조정관 밑에 기획재정담당관ㆍ혁신행정담당관ㆍ규제개혁법무담당관ㆍ국제협력담당관ㆍ정보화담당관ㆍ고객지원담당관ㆍ비상안전담당관 및 데이터혁신기획팀을 두되, 기획재정담당관ㆍ혁신행정담당관ㆍ규제개혁법무담당관ㆍ국제협력담당관ㆍ정보화담당관 및 고객지원담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 비상안전담당관은 임기제 서기관으로, 데이터혁신기획팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ식품위생사무관ㆍ수의사무관ㆍ약무사무관ㆍ의료기술사무관ㆍ전산사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2013. 10. 4., 2013. 12. 18., 2017. 9. 28., 2020. 8. 31., 2023. 8. 30., 2025. 7. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② Under the Director of Planning and Coordination, there shall be a Planning and Finance Officer, an Innovation Administration Officer, a Regulatory Reform and Legal Affairs Officer, an International Cooperation Officer, an Information Technology Officer, a Customer Support Officer, an Emergency Safety Officer, and a Data Innovation Planning Team. The Planning and Finance Officer, the Innovation Administration Officer, the Regulatory Reform and Legal Affairs Officer, the International Cooperation Officer, the Information Technology Officer, and the Customer Support Officer shall be appointed as Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary; the Emergency Safety Officer shall be appointed as a fixed-term Secretary; and the Head of the Data Innovation Planning Team shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Food Hygiene Officer, Veterinary Officer, Pharmaceutical Officer, Medical Technology Officer, Computer Officer, or Administrative Officer. <Amended Oct. 4, 2013; Dec. 18, 2013; Sep. 28, 2017; Aug. 31, 2020; Aug. 30, 2023; Jul. 31, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 기획재정담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정관을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Planning and Finance Officer assists the Planning and Coordination Officer with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 각종 정책 및 계획의 수립ㆍ종합 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Formulation, synthesis, and coordination of various policies and plans

rows.source_ko: 2. 주요 업무계획의 수립ㆍ종합 및 조정
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment, Synthesis, and Coordination of Major Work Plans

rows.source_ko: 3. 주요 정책 현안 과제 발굴ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Identification and Coordination of Major Policy Issues

rows.source_ko: 4. 갈등관리 업무의 총괄 및 조정
rows.text_en: 4. Overall management and coordination of conflict management tasks

rows.source_ko: 5. 연구개발사업 조정 총괄
rows.text_en: 5. Overall coordination of R&D projects

rows.source_ko: 6. 국회업무보고 등 국회관련 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 6. Overall management of National Assembly-related affairs, including National Assembly business reports.

rows.source_ko: 7. 예산의 편성ㆍ집행의 조정 및 결산
rows.text_en: 7. Coordination of budget formulation and execution, and settlement of accounts

rows.source_ko: 8. 식품의약품안전처 소관 기금운용의 총괄
rows.text_en: 8. Overall management of fund operations under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety

rows.source_ko: 9. 주요 사업의 중기재정계획 수립 및 조정
rows.text_en: 9. Establishment and coordination of medium-term financial plans for major projects

rows.source_ko: 10. 재정사업 자율평가 계획 수립 및 총괄
rows.text_en: 10. Establishment of a plan for autonomous evaluation of financial projects and overall management

rows.source_ko: 11. 그 밖에 관내 다른 담당관의 주관에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other officials within the jurisdiction

④ The Director of Innovation Administration assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters. <Amended Oct. 4, 2013; Sep. 28, 2017; Dec. 15, 2017; Dec. 11, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 업무처리절차 및 조직문화의 개선 총괄 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of work process and organizational culture improvement

rows.source_ko: 2. 행정 제도개선에 관한 계획의 수립 및 집행
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and execution of plans for administrative system improvement

rows.source_ko: 3. 자체 제안제도 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the operation of the internal suggestion system

rows.source_ko: 4. 각종 공약 및 지시사항 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Management of various pledges and directives

rows.source_ko: 5. 조직 진단 및 평가를 통한 조직과 정원 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Organization and Staffing Management through Organizational Diagnosis and Evaluation

rows.source_ko: 6. 처내 업무분장의 조정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the adjustment of internal division of duties

rows.source_ko: 7. 위임전결 및 사무분장에 관한 규정 관리
rows.text_en: 7. Management of Regulations on Delegation of Authority and Division of Duties

rows.source_ko: 8. 처내 각종 위원회 운영 현황 관리
rows.text_en: 8. Management of the operational status of various internal committees

rows.source_ko: 9. 성과관리계획의 수립 및 성과관리 총괄
rows.text_en: 9. Establishment of Performance Management Plan and Overall Performance Management

rows.source_ko: 10. 정부업무평가, 성별영향평가 등 외부평가의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 10. Overall management and coordination of external evaluations, such as government performance evaluations and gender impact assessments

rows.source_ko: 11. 부서평가 및 직무성과계약제 운영
rows.text_en: 11. Operation of Department Evaluation and Job Performance Contract System

rows.source_ko: 12. 주요 업무 진도 관리
rows.text_en: 12. Key Task Progress Management

rows.source_ko: 13. 처 내 정부혁신 관련 과제 발굴ㆍ선정, 추진상황 확인ㆍ점검 및 관리
rows.text_en: 13. Identification and selection of government innovation-related tasks within the Ministry, and verification, monitoring, and management of implementation status

rows.source_ko: 14. 처 내 일자리 정책의 총괄, 제도 개선 및 추진 상황 확인ㆍ점검
rows.text_en: 14. Overall management of employment policies within the Ministry, institutional improvement, and verification and monitoring of implementation status

rows.source_ko: 15. 처 내 중앙행정기관, 지방자치단체, 공공기관, 기업, 단체 등과의 협업 추진에 관한 업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 15. Overall management and coordination of tasks related to promoting collaboration with central administrative agencies, local governments, public institutions, companies, organizations, etc. within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 규제개혁법무담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정관을 보좌한다. <개정 2020. 2. 27.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Officer for Regulatory Reform and Legal Affairs assists the Officer for Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters. <Amended Feb. 27, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법령ㆍ행정규칙안의 입안ㆍ심사 등 법제 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management of legislative affairs, including the drafting and review of draft laws and administrative rules

rows.source_ko: 2. 국회 입법지원
rows.text_en: 2. Legislative Support for the National Assembly

rows.source_ko: 3. 국무회의 및 차관회의 안건에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning agenda items for the Cabinet meeting and the Vice-Ministers' meeting

rows.source_ko: 4. 법령 질의회신 및 처분 자문 총괄
rows.text_en: 4. Overall management of legal inquiries, responses, and consultation on dispositions

rows.source_ko: 5. 입법계획의 수립 및 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and Management of Legislative Plans

rows.source_ko: 6. 행정절차제도 운영
rows.text_en: 6. Operation of the Administrative Procedure System

rows.source_ko: 7. 행정심판 및 소송사무 총괄
rows.text_en: 7. Overall management of administrative appeals and litigation affairs

rows.source_ko: 8. 식품의약품안전처 소관 비영리 법인 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 8. Overall management of affairs for non-profit corporations under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety

rows.source_ko: 9. 규제개혁 총괄
rows.text_en: 9. Overall Regulatory Reform

rows.source_ko: 10. 규제심사 및 자체규제심사위원회 운영
rows.text_en: 10. Regulatory Review and Operation of the Internal Regulatory Review Committee

rows.source_ko: 11. 행정조사의 총괄 관리
rows.text_en: 11. Overall Management of Administrative Investigations

rows.source_ko: 12. 식품(농수산물, 그 가공품, 축산물 및 주류를 포함한다. 이하 같다)ㆍ건강기능식품ㆍ의약품ㆍ마약류ㆍ화장품ㆍ의약외품ㆍ의료기기 및 위생용품 등(이하 “식품ㆍ의약품등”이라 한다)에 관한 지침서ㆍ해설서 등의 총괄 관리
rows.text_en: 12. Overall management of guidelines, explanatory documents, etc. concerning food (including agricultural and fishery products, processed products thereof, livestock products, and alcoholic beverages; hereinafter the same applies), health functional foods, pharmaceuticals, narcotics, cosmetics, quasi-pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and sanitary products, etc. (hereinafter referred to as “food, pharmaceuticals, etc.”)

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 국제협력담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정관을 보좌한다. <개정 2017. 12. 15.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Officer for International Cooperation assists the Director for Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters. <Amended Dec. 15, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 국제통상 및 국제협력 총괄 ㆍ 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of international trade and international cooperation regarding food, pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 세계무역기구(WTO)의 식품ㆍ의약품등 분야 협상ㆍ이행 및 무역분쟁 업무
rows.text_en: 2. World Trade Organization (WTO) negotiations, implementation, and trade dispute affairs in the fields of food, drugs, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. 자유무역협정(FTA)에 관한 식품ㆍ의약품등 분야 협상 및 이행
rows.text_en: 3. Negotiations and Implementation of Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) in the Food, Pharmaceutical, and Other Sectors

rows.source_ko: 4. 세계보건기구(WHO), 세계무역기구(WTO) 등 국제기구와의 협력업무
rows.text_en: 4. Cooperation with international organizations such as the World Health Organization (WHO) and the World Trade Organization (WTO)

rows.source_ko: 5. 외국정부와의 통상 현안대응 및 식품ㆍ의약품등 기관 간 약정 체결
rows.text_en: 5. Responding to trade issues with foreign governments and concluding inter-agency agreements regarding food, pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. 농축수산물 위생ㆍ안전 관련 국제협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning international cooperation regarding hygiene and safety of agricultural, livestock, and fishery products

rows.source_ko: 7. 공무국외출장 총괄 및 조정
rows.text_en: 7. Overall management and coordination of official overseas business trips

rows.source_ko: 8. 재외공관 주재관의 관리
rows.text_en: 8. Management of Attachés at Overseas Missions

rows.source_ko: 9. 식품의약품안전처 소관 공적개발원조(ODA) 사업 관리 및 평가 총괄
rows.text_en: 9. Overall management and evaluation of Official Development Assistance (ODA) projects under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 정보화담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정관을 보좌한다. <개정 2020. 8. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Information Technology Officer assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters. <Amended Aug. 31, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 중장기 정보화계획 수립 및 평가
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and Evaluation of Mid-to-Long-Term Informatization Plans for Food, Pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 정보화 관련 예산의 사전검토 조정
rows.text_en: 2. Prior review and adjustment of informatization-related budget

rows.source_ko: 3. 정보기술아키텍처 구축 및 운영
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and Operation of Information Technology Architecture

rows.source_ko: 4. 행정정보의 공동 활용
rows.text_en: 4. Joint Use of Administrative Information

rows.source_ko: 5. 정보시스템 개발ㆍ운영 및 유지보수
rows.text_en: 5. Information System Development, Operation, and Maintenance

rows.source_ko: 6. 정보보안 및 개인정보보호제도 운영계획 수립 및 시행
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment and Implementation of Operation Plan for Information Security and Personal Information Protection Systems

rows.source_ko: 7. 정보화 표준화 계획 수립 및 시행
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment and Implementation of Informatization Standardization Plan

rows.source_ko: 8. 정보통신망 운영 계획 수립 및 시행
rows.text_en: 8. Establishment and Implementation of Information and Communications Network Operation Plan

rows.source_ko: 9. 정보화자원 관리
rows.text_en: 9. Information Resource Management

rows.source_ko: 10. 홈페이지 등 웹사이트 구축 및 운영
rows.text_en: 10. Construction and operation of websites, including homepages

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 고객지원담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정관을 보좌한다
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Customer Support Officer assists the Planning and Coordination Officer with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 고객만족도 향상을 위한 종합계획의 수립 및 시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of a comprehensive plan to improve customer satisfaction

rows.source_ko: 2. 민원제도 개선계획의 수립 등 민원업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management and coordination of civil complaint affairs, including the establishment of plans to improve the civil complaint system

rows.source_ko: 3. 식품ㆍ의약품등에 관한 고객지원 정책 개발
rows.text_en: 3. Development of Customer Support Policies for Food, Pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 행정서비스헌장의 운영에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the operation of the Administrative Service Charter

rows.source_ko: 5. 민원상담 종합계획의 수립ㆍ시행 및 종합상담센터의 운영
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and implementation of a comprehensive plan for civil complaint consultation and operation of the Comprehensive Consultation Center

rows.source_ko: 6. 식품ㆍ의약품등에 대한 상담 및 질의 회신
rows.text_en: 6. Consultation and Response to Inquiries Regarding Food, Drugs, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 상담사례에 대한 데이터베이스 구축 및 상담을 통한 제도개선사항 수집
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment of a database on counseling cases and collection of suggestions for institutional improvement through counseling

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 비상안전담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정관을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Emergency Safety Officer assists the Planning and Coordination Officer with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국가비상사태에 대비한 제반 계획 및 훈련의 통제ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Control and coordination of all plans and drills in preparation for a national emergency

rows.source_ko: 2. 비상 대비 중점관리업체 및 정부비축물자의 관리
rows.text_en: 2. Management of Key Emergency Preparedness Companies and Government Stockpiles

rows.source_ko: 3. 국가 중요시설 및 중앙긴급복구 목표의 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of National Critical Facilities and Central Emergency Recovery Objectives

rows.source_ko: 4. 직장예비군 및 직장민방위대의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Management of Workplace Reserve Forces and Workplace Civil Defense Corps

rows.source_ko: 5. 처내 안전관리ㆍ재난상황 및 위기상황 관리기관과의 연계체계 구축ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and operation of a linkage system with internal safety management, disaster, and crisis management agencies

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 데이터혁신기획팀장은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정관을 보좌한다. <개정 2025. 7. 31.>
rows.text_en: 10. The Head of the Data Innovation Planning Team assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters. <Amended July 31, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 데이터 및 통계에 관한 정책 및 제도의 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Planning and coordination of policies and systems regarding data and statistics on food, pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 데이터 관련 인공지능 등 신기술 적용 및 활용의 총괄ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management and support of the application and utilization of new technologies, such as artificial intelligence, related to data on food, pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 공공데이터 수집, 표준화, 품질관리, 개방 및 활용
rows.text_en: 3. Collection, Standardization, Quality Control, Openness, and Utilization of Public Data on Food, Pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 통계 개발ㆍ개선 및 국가승인통계의 발굴ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 4. Development and improvement of statistics on food, pharmaceuticals, etc., and discovery and management of nationally approved statistics

rows.source_ko: 5. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 데이터ㆍ통계기반 정책분석 및 식품ㆍ의약품 통계 품질관리
rows.text_en: 5. Data and Statistics-Based Policy Analysis of Food and Pharmaceuticals, etc., and Quality Control of Food and Pharmaceutical Statistics

rows.source_ko: 6. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 데이터 기반의 활용을 위한 데이터센터 운영 및 관련 플랫폼 구축
rows.text_en: 6. Operation of data centers and establishment of related platforms for data-based utilization of food, pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 식품의약품안전백서 및 통계연보 등 간행물 발간
rows.text_en: 7. Publication of periodicals such as the Food and Drug Safety White Paper and Statistical Yearbook

rows.source_ko: 8. 처 내 데이터ㆍ통계 관련 역량 강화 계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 8. Establishment and implementation of a plan to strengthen data and statistics-related capabilities within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: 제5조(감사담당관) 감사담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Audit Officer) The Audit Officer shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제6조(위해사범중앙조사단) 위해사범중앙조사단장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Central Investigation Unit for Harmful Crimes) The Head of the Central Investigation Unit for Harmful Crimes shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>
Article 6-2 Deleted <July 17, 2024>
Article 6-3 Deleted <July 17, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제6조의4(사이버조사팀장) ① 차장 밑에 사이버조사팀장 1명을 둔다. <개정 2024. 12. 31., 2026. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 6-4 (Cyber ​​Investigation Team Leader) ① One Cyber ​​Investigation Team Leader shall be appointed under the Deputy Commissioner. <Amended Dec. 31, 2024; Mar. 24, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 사이버조사팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ식품위생사무관ㆍ수의사무관ㆍ약무사무관ㆍ의료기술사무관ㆍ전산사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Cyber ​​Investigation Team shall be appointed from among the Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, Officer for Food Hygiene, Officer for Veterinary Affairs, Officer for Pharmaceutical Affairs, Officer for Medical Technology, Officer for Computer Science, or Officer for Administration. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 사이버조사팀장은 다음 사항에 관하여 차장을 보좌한다. <개정 2024. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Cyber ​​Investigation Team assists the Deputy Minister in the following matters. <Amended Dec. 31, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 온라인상에서의 허위표시ㆍ과대광고 및 불법유통 관련 모니터링과 사후관리 등에 관한 정책 개발, 계획 수립ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 1. Development of policies, establishment of plans, and operation regarding monitoring and follow-up management of false labeling, exaggerated advertising, and illegal distribution of food, pharmaceuticals, etc. online

rows.source_ko: 2. 온라인상에서의 허위표시ㆍ과대광고ㆍ불법유통 식품ㆍ의약품등의 수거 검사 및 실태조사 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management and coordination of the collection, inspection, and fact-finding investigation of food, pharmaceuticals, etc., involving false labeling, exaggerated advertising, or illegal distribution online

rows.source_ko: 3. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 온라인상에서의 허위표시ㆍ과대광고 및 불법유통에 대한 모니터링ㆍ감시ㆍ사후관리와 위반사항에 대한 검증 및 확인
rows.text_en: 3. Monitoring, surveillance, and follow-up management regarding false labeling, exaggerated advertising, and illegal distribution of food, pharmaceuticals, etc. online, as well as verification and confirmation of violations

rows.source_ko: 4. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 온라인상에서의 허위표시ㆍ과대광고 및 불법유통 조사 결과 등에 관한 공표 및 통계관리(통계관리에는 사후관리 사항을 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 4. Publication and statistical management regarding the results of investigations into false labeling, exaggerated advertising, and illegal distribution of food, pharmaceuticals, etc. online (statistical management includes matters for follow-up management)

rows.source_ko: 5. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 온라인상에서의 안전관리 분야 대외 협력 및 교육에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning external cooperation and education in the field of online safety management of food, pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 온라인 모니터링 시스템 구축 및 운영
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment and Operation of an Online Monitoring System for Food, Pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 온라인 시민감시단과 민간 광고 검증단의 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the operation of the Online Citizen Monitoring Group and the Private Advertising Verification Group

rows.source_ko: 8. 그 밖에 식품ㆍ의약품등의 온라인상에서의 허위표시ㆍ과대광고 및 불법유통 관리에 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Other matters necessary for the management of false labeling, exaggerated advertising, and illegal distribution of food, pharmaceuticals, etc. online
[This Article Newly Inserted Feb. 28, 2022]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(운영지원과) 운영지원과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Operations Support Division) The Head of the Operations Support Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary of Science and Technology, or Secretary. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제8조(소비자위해예방국) ① 소비자위해예방국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Consumer Hazard Prevention Bureau) ① The Director of the Consumer Hazard Prevention Bureau shall be appointed from among general civil servants, health research officers, or industrial research officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 소비자위해예방국에 위해예방정책과ㆍ위해정보과ㆍ통합식품데이터기획과ㆍ시험검사정책과 및 위생용품정책과를 두되, 위해예방정책과장ㆍ통합식품데이터기획과장ㆍ시험검사정책과장 및 위생용품정책과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 위해정보과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2016. 5. 19., 2020. 2. 27., 2020. 8. 31., 2023. 6. 1., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Consumer Risk Prevention Bureau shall have the Risk Prevention Policy Division, Risk Information Division, Integrated Food Data Planning Division, Testing and Inspection Policy Division, and Sanitary Products Policy Division; provided that the heads of the Risk Prevention Policy Division, Integrated Food Data Planning Division, Testing and Inspection Policy Division, and Sanitary Products Policy Division shall be appointed as Deputy Director-General, Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, or Senior Secretary, and the head of the Risk Information Division shall be appointed as Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, Health Research Officer, or Industrial Research Officer. <Amended May 19, 2016; Feb. 27, 2020; Aug. 31, 2020; Jun. 1, 2023; Aug. 30, 2023>
③ The Head of the Risk Prevention Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jul. 29, 2016; Mar. 21, 2017; Aug. 31, 2020; Feb. 23, 2024; Oct. 7, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 식품ㆍ의약품등 소비자 권익의 보호증진을 위한 소비자 정책 개발
rows.text_en: 1. Development of consumer policies to protect and promote consumer rights and interests regarding food, pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 소비자 안전 관련 유관기관과의 업무 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning business cooperation with relevant organizations regarding consumer safety

rows.source_ko: 3. 식품ㆍ의약품등 위해예방을 위한 정책 개발
rows.text_en: 3. Development of policies for the prevention of hazards related to food, pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 유해물질 안전관리 종합계획 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment and coordination of comprehensive safety management plans for hazardous substances in food, pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 5. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 안전사고 긴급대응체계 구축ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and Management of an Emergency Response System for Safety Accidents of Food, Drugs, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 위해평가관리체계 구축 운영
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment and Operation of a Risk Assessment and Management System for Food, Drugs, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 위해평가 및 위해관리실시 여부 등을 결정하기 위한 선행조사
rows.text_en: 7. Preliminary investigation to determine whether to implement risk assessment and risk management, etc.

rows.source_ko: 8. 사전 예방적 초기 위해관리 활동
rows.text_en: 8. Proactive early risk management activities

rows.source_ko: 9. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 안전 정책현안 관리 및 분석
rows.text_en: 9. Management and Analysis of Current Policy Issues Regarding the Safety of Food, Drugs, etc.

rows.source_ko: 10. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 위해요소에 대한 잠정 안전관리 방안의 수립
rows.text_en: 10. Establishment of provisional safety management measures for hazardous elements in food, pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 11. 식품ㆍ의약품등에 대한 유해물질별 위해개요서 작성 총괄
rows.text_en: 11. Overall Management of Risk Summary Reports by Hazardous Substance for Food, Pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 12. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 제품별 위해요소 탐색 및 안전관리 대안의 조정ㆍ총괄
rows.text_en: 12. Identification of hazardous elements and coordination and overall management of safety management alternatives for products such as food and pharmaceuticals

rows.source_ko: 13. 유해물질 모니터링자료 데이터베이스 구축, 자료 분석 및 활용방안 수립 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 13. Overall management and coordination of the establishment of a hazardous substance monitoring data database, data analysis, and the formulation of utilization plans.

rows.source_ko: 14. 처내 위해예방 활동ㆍ실적 분석ㆍ평가 및 우수부서 발굴 포상
rows.text_en: 14. Analysis and evaluation of internal hazard prevention activities and performance, and identification and rewarding of outstanding departments

rows.source_ko: 15. 「식품ㆍ의약품 등의 안전 및 제품화 지원에 관한 규제과학혁신법」의 개정 및 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 15. Matters concerning the amendment and operation of the "Regulatory Science and Innovation Act on the Safety and Commercialization Support of Food, Drugs, etc."

rows.source_ko: 16. 규제과학혁신을 위한 기본계획 및 연도별 시행계획 수립ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 16. Establishment and operation of the Basic Plan and Annual Implementation Plan for Regulatory Science Innovation

rows.source_ko: 17. 식품ㆍ의약품등에 대한 소통 관련 종합계획 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 17. Establishment and implementation of a comprehensive plan regarding communication concerning food, pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 18. 위해정보에 대한 사전예방적 소통 활동 및 프로그램 운영
rows.text_en: 18. Operation of proactive communication activities and programs regarding hazard information

rows.source_ko: 19. 대국민 소통향상을 위한 자문위원회 및 관계부처와 소통협의체 운영
rows.text_en: 19. Operation of an advisory committee and a communication consultative body with relevant ministries to improve communication with the public

rows.source_ko: 20. 소통 기법 개발 및 교육
rows.text_en: 20. Development and Training of Communication Techniques

rows.source_ko: 21. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 안전인식 제고를 위한 대국민 소통
rows.text_en: 21. Public Communication to Enhance Safety Awareness of Food, Drugs, etc.

rows.source_ko: 22. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 정책 현안에 대한 관계부처 및 단체 간 소통의 조정 협력
rows.text_en: 22. Coordination and cooperation in communication among relevant ministries and organizations regarding policy issues concerning food, pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 23. 민간 전문기관을 활용한 소통컨설팅 등 지원
rows.text_en: 23. Support, such as communication consulting utilizing private specialized agencies

rows.source_ko: 24. 소비자 단체 지원 및 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 24. Matters concerning support and cooperation with consumer organizations

rows.source_ko: 25. 그 밖에 국내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 25. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other domestic divisions
④ Deleted <2020. 8. 31.>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 위해정보과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Risk Information Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 국내외 위해정보 수집
rows.text_en: 1. Collection of domestic and international risk information on food, pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 위해정보의 분석 및 평가
rows.text_en: 2. Analysis and Evaluation of Risk Information

rows.source_ko: 3. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 위해정보 전파, 교류 및 대외협력 등 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of dissemination, exchange, and external cooperation regarding risk information on food, pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 위해정보 활용 및 관리를 위한 계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment and implementation of plans for the utilization and management of risk information

rows.source_ko: 5. 위해정보 수집ㆍ분석체계의 구축 및 기법 개발
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment of a Risk Information Collection and Analysis System and Development of Techniques

rows.source_ko: 6. 해외 현지정보 수집망의 구축ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment and Operation of Overseas Local Information Collection Networks

rows.source_ko: 7. 식품안전정보원의 위해정보 수집 등에 대한 교육 및 운영ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 7. Education and Operation/Management of the Food Safety Information Center's Collection of Hazardous Information, etc.

rows.source_ko: 8. 국내외 위해에 관한 주요 조사연구 발표 자료의 신속한 입수ㆍ분석ㆍ조치를 위한 종합계획의 수립ㆍ시행 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 8. Establishment, implementation, and overall coordination of comprehensive plans for the rapid acquisition, analysis, and action regarding key research findings and published data on domestic and international risks

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 통합식품데이터기획과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2016. 5. 19., 2020. 8. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Integrated Food Data Planning Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly established May 19, 2016; Aug. 31, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 중앙행정기관 식품안전정보 연계ㆍ통합 및 활용 정책 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and coordination of policies for linking, integrating, and utilizing food safety information from central administrative agencies

rows.source_ko: 2. 통합식품안전정보망 운영 총괄 및 지원
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management and support of the Integrated Food Safety Information Network

rows.source_ko: 3. 식품안전정보 발굴 및 연계 등을 위한 관련 행정기관과의 협업
rows.text_en: 3. Collaboration with relevant administrative agencies for the discovery and linkage of food safety information, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 식품안전정보 표준화 등 관리 및 활용에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the management and utilization of food safety information, including standardization

rows.source_ko: 5. 대국민ㆍ산업체 등 맞춤형 통합식품 정보 서비스 제공
rows.text_en: 5. Provision of customized integrated food information services for the public, industry, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. 통합식품안전정보망 활용도 제고를 위한 기능 고도화에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning functional enhancement to improve the utilization of the Integrated Food Safety Information Network

rows.source_ko: 7. 통합식품안전정보망의 개인정보보호 및 보안대책에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning personal information protection and security measures of the Integrated Food Safety Information Network
⑦ The Head of the Testing and Inspection Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Aug. 20, 2014; May 19, 2016; Aug. 31, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 식품ㆍ의약품분야 시험ㆍ검사 관련 법령 제정ㆍ개정 및 제도개선 총괄 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall coordination of the enactment and amendment of laws and regulations and institutional improvements related to testing and inspection in the food and pharmaceutical sectors

rows.source_ko: 2. 시험ㆍ검사기관의 시험ㆍ검사품질 강화 및 종합 발전계획 수립
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of a comprehensive development plan for strengthening the quality of testing and inspection at testing and inspection institutions

rows.source_ko: 3. 식품ㆍ의약품분야 시험ㆍ검사기관(식품 등 시험ㆍ검사기관 중 자가품질위탁 시험ㆍ검사기관은 제외한다)의 지정ㆍ지도ㆍ감독 및 행정처분
rows.text_en: 3. Designation, guidance, supervision, and administrative disposition of testing and inspection institutions in the food and pharmaceutical sectors (excluding testing and inspection institutions for self-quality outsourcing among testing and inspection institutions for food, etc.)

rows.source_ko: 4. 국외시험ㆍ검사기관 지정 및 사후관리
rows.text_en: 4. Designation of Overseas Testing and Inspection Institutions and Post-Designation Management

rows.source_ko: 5. 식품ㆍ의약품분야 시험ㆍ검사기관의 시험ㆍ검사능력 평가ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 5. Evaluation and Management of Testing and Inspection Capabilities of Testing and Inspection Institutions in the Food and Pharmaceutical Sectors

rows.source_ko: 6. 시험ㆍ검사기관에 대한 교육 및 지원 총괄
rows.text_en: 6. Overall management of training and support for testing and inspection agencies

rows.source_ko: 7. 처내 시험ㆍ검사 관련 업무 조정 및 협력
rows.text_en: 7. Coordination and cooperation of internal testing and inspection-related tasks

rows.source_ko: 8. 특별시ㆍ광역시ㆍ특별자치시ㆍ도ㆍ특별자치도의 보건환경연구원 업무협력체계의 구축
rows.text_en: 8. Establishment of a cooperation system among health and environment research institutes of Special Cities, Metropolitan Cities, Special Self-Governing Cities, Provinces, and Special Self-Governing Provinces

rows.source_ko: 9. 국제기준의 선진 시험ㆍ검사관리제도 도입
rows.text_en: 9. Introduction of an advanced testing and inspection management system based on international standards

rows.source_ko: 10. 시험장비의 도입 및 밸리데이션(validation) 등 관리 총괄
rows.text_en: 10. Overall management of test equipment introduction and validation, etc.

rows.source_ko: 11. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 표준품 및 표준시료 관리 총괄
rows.text_en: 11. Overall Management of Standards and Standard Samples for Food, Pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 위생용품정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2020. 2. 27.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Head of the Sanitary Products Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly added Feb. 27, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「위생용품관리법」의 개정 및 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the amendment and operation of the Sanitary Products Management Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 위생용품의 안전관리 정책 수립 및 제도 운영
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of Safety Management Policies and Operation of Systems for Sanitary Products

rows.source_ko: 3. 위생용품 영업의 지도ㆍ단속, 수거ㆍ검사, 허위표시ㆍ과대광고 등 감시 업무 및 행정제재 총괄
rows.text_en: 3. Overall management of guidance and enforcement of hygiene product businesses, collection and inspection, monitoring of false labeling and exaggerated advertising, and administrative sanctions

rows.source_ko: 4. 수입위생용품 검사계획의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment and coordination of inspection plans for imported sanitary products

rows.source_ko: 5. 위생용품의 생산실적 등 통계관리
rows.text_en: 5. Statistical management of production performance, etc. of sanitary products

rows.source_ko: 6. 식품의약품안전처 소속 위생용품위생감시원의 임면 및 교육에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the appointment, dismissal, and training of hygiene product inspectors under the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety

rows.source_ko: 7. 위생용품 관련 단체의 관리 및 위생교육 제도 운영
rows.text_en: 7. Management of organizations related to hygiene products and operation of hygiene education systems

rows.source_ko: 8. 위생용품의 기준ㆍ규격의 설정, 시험 방법의 관리 및 기준ㆍ규격 등에 관한 종합계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 8. Establishment of standards and specifications for sanitary products, management of test methods, and formulation and implementation of comprehensive plans regarding standards and specifications, etc.

rows.source_ko: 제9조(식품안전정책국) ① 식품안전정책국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2020. 8. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Food Safety Policy Bureau) ① The Director of the Food Safety Policy Bureau shall be appointed from among general civil servants, health research officers, or industrial research officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of such position shall be Grade B. <Amended Aug. 31, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 「식품의약품안전처와 그 소속기관 직제」 제12조제1항에 따라 식품안전정책국장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 식품기준기획관으로 하며, 식품기준기획관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보하되 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 보한다. <신설 2020. 8. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety and Its Affiliated Agencies,” the advisory body placed under the Director General of the Food Safety Policy Bureau shall be the Director General of Food Standards Planning; the Director General of Food Standards Planning shall be appointed from among general civil servants, health research officers, or industrial research officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. <Newly added Aug. 31, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ③ 식품기준기획관은 「식품의약품안전처와 그 소속기관 직제」 제12조제3항제24호부터 제27호까지, 제32호부터 제34호까지 및 제44호부터 제46호까지의 사항에 관하여 국장을 보좌한다. <신설 2020. 8. 31.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Director General for Food Standards Planning assists the Director General with respect to matters specified in Article 12, Paragraph 3, Subparagraphs 24 through 27 , 32 through 34, and 44 through 46 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety and Its Affiliated Agencies.” <Newly added Aug. 31, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ④ 식품안전정책국에 식품안전정책과ㆍ식품관리총괄과ㆍ식중독예방과ㆍ식품안전인증과ㆍ식품표시광고정책과ㆍ식품기준과ㆍ유해물질기준과 및 첨가물기준과를 두되, 식품안전정책과장ㆍ식품관리총괄과장ㆍ식품안전인증과장 및 식품표시광고정책과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 수석전문관으로, 식중독예방과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ공업연구관 또는 수석전문관으로, 식품기준과장 및 첨가물기준과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로, 유해물질기준과장은 과학기술서기관 또는 보건연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2017. 3. 21., 2020. 1. 9., 2020. 8. 31., 2023. 8. 30., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Food Safety Policy Bureau shall have the Food Safety Policy Division, Food Management Division, Food Poisoning Prevention Division, Food Safety Certification Division, Food Labeling and Advertising Policy Division, Food Standards Division, Hazardous Substances Standards Division, and Additives Standards Division; provided that the heads of the Food Safety Policy Division, Food Management Division, Food Safety Certification Division, and Food Labeling and Advertising Policy Division shall be appointed as Deputy Director-General, Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, or Senior Specialist; the head of the Food Poisoning Prevention Division shall be appointed as Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Health Research Officer, Industrial Research Officer, or Senior Specialist; the heads of the Food Standards Division and the Additives Standards Division shall be appointed as Secretary of Science and Technology, Health Research Officer, or Industrial Research Officer; and the head of the Hazardous Substances Standards Division shall be appointed as Secretary of Science and Technology or Health Research Officer. <Amended Mar. 21, 2017; Jan. 9, 2020; Aug. 31, 2020; Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 30, 2025>
⑤ The Head of the Food Safety Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Oct. 4, 2013; Jan. 9, 2015; Mar. 21, 2017; Dec. 11, 2018; Aug. 31, 2020; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 식품, 식품첨가물, 기구 또는 용기ㆍ포장(이하 “식품등”이라 한다)의 위생ㆍ안전관리 정책 수립 및 제도개선 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of hygiene and safety management policies and institutional improvements for food, food additives, equipment, or containers and packaging (hereinafter referred to as “food, etc.”)

rows.source_ko: 2. 「식품위생법」 및 「식품안전기본법」의 개정 및 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the amendment and operation of the Food Sanitation Act and the Framework Act on Food Safety

rows.source_ko: 3. 식품등[축산물 및 해외로부터 국내로 수입되는 식품등(이하 “수입식품등” 이라 한다)은 제외한다]의 영업 허가ㆍ신고 및 등록 관련 업무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 3. Overall management of business permits, notifications, and registrations for food products, etc. [excluding livestock products and food products, etc. imported into the country from overseas (hereinafter referred to as “imported food products, etc.”)]

rows.source_ko: 4. 식품등(축산물 및 수입식품등은 제외한다)과 관련한 법인ㆍ단체의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Management of corporations and organizations related to food, etc. (excluding livestock products and imported food, etc.)

rows.source_ko: 5. 식품등과 건강기능식품의 기준ㆍ규격 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Overall management and coordination of standards and specifications for foods and health functional foods

rows.source_ko: 6. 식품등(농축수산물 및 수입식품등은 제외한다)의 사건ㆍ사고 대응 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 6. Overall management of response duties for incidents and accidents involving food, etc. (excluding agricultural, livestock, and fishery products and imported food, etc.)

rows.source_ko: 7. 식품안전정책위원회 사무에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the affairs of the Food Safety Policy Committee

rows.source_ko: 8. 식품위생심의위원회의 운영
rows.text_en: 8. Operation of the Food Hygiene Deliberation Committee

rows.source_ko: 9. 「식품위생법」에 따른 자가품질검사 제도의 운영
rows.text_en: 9. Operation of the self-quality inspection system pursuant to the Food Sanitation Act

rows.source_ko: 10. 식품진흥기금 운영
rows.text_en: 10. Operation of the Food Promotion Fund

rows.source_ko: 11. 국제식품규격위원회(CODEX) 등 식품안전관련 국제협력 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 11. Overall management of international cooperation related to food safety, including the Codex Alimentarius Commission (CODEX)

rows.source_ko: 12. 식품등(농축수산물 및 수입식품등은 제외한다)의 위생ㆍ안전 관련 국제협력 업무
rows.text_en: 12. International cooperation affairs regarding hygiene and safety of food, etc. (excluding agricultural, livestock, and fishery products and imported food, etc.)

rows.source_ko: 13. 관계 부처 및 기관 업무 협의의 조정 총괄
rows.text_en: 13. Overall coordination of business consultations with relevant ministries and agencies

rows.source_ko: 14. 식품 위생 및 안전 관련 공무원 교육
rows.text_en: 14. Training for Public Officials Related to Food Hygiene and Safety

rows.source_ko: 15. 식품등의 생산실적 등 통계관리
rows.text_en: 15. Statistical Management of Production Performance, etc. of Food Products

rows.source_ko: 16. 식품안전정보원의 지원 및 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 16. Support, guidance, and supervision by the Food Safety Information Center

rows.source_ko: 17. 그 밖에 국내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 17. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other domestic divisions
⑥ The Head of the Food Management Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jan. 9, 2015; May 19, 2016; Mar. 21, 2017; Aug. 31, 2020; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 식품등(농축수산물 및 수입식품등은 제외한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다) 관련 영업의 지도ㆍ단속 등에 관한 종합계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of a comprehensive plan regarding guidance, enforcement, etc., of businesses related to food, etc. (excluding agricultural, livestock, and fishery products and imported food, etc.; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph)

rows.source_ko: 2. 식품등의 수거 및 검사계획 수립ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and management of collection and inspection plans for food, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. 부정ㆍ불량 식품등의 단속 및 단속업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Enforcement of illegal or substandard food, etc., and overall management and coordination of enforcement duties

rows.source_ko: 4. 식품등에 관한 감시업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Overall management and coordination of surveillance duties regarding food, etc.

rows.source_ko: 5. 식품등의 허위표시 및 과대광고 단속의 지도ㆍ감독 및 조정
rows.text_en: 5. Guidance, supervision, and coordination of enforcement against false labeling and exaggerated advertising of food products

rows.source_ko: 6. 부적합 식품등 긴급통보 운영ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 6. Operation and Management of Emergency Notification for Non-compliant Foods, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 위해 식품등의 회수ㆍ관리 총괄
rows.text_en: 7. Overall management of recall and management of hazardous foods, etc.

rows.source_ko: 8. 식품등의 사건ㆍ사고 대응
rows.text_en: 8. Response to incidents and accidents involving food, etc.

rows.source_ko: 9. 식품등에 대한 신고포상금제도의 운영
rows.text_en: 9. Operation of the reward system for reporting food, etc.

rows.source_ko: 10. 식품안전소비자신고센터 운영 및 관리
rows.text_en: 10. Operation and Management of the Food Safety Consumer Complaint Center

rows.source_ko: 11. 식품등의 이물보고에 관한 제도 운영 및 이물 등에 대한 조사ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 11. Operation of the System for Reporting Foreign Matter in Food, etc. and Investigation and Management of Foreign Matter, etc.

rows.source_ko: 12. 식품등의 지도ㆍ단속, 위반현황, 행정처분, 수거ㆍ검사결과 등에 관한 통계 관리
rows.text_en: 12. Statistical management regarding guidance and enforcement of food, etc., violation status, administrative dispositions, collection and inspection results, etc.

rows.source_ko: 13. 전국합동단속 계획수립 및 시행
rows.text_en: 13. Establishment and Implementation of Nationwide Joint Enforcement Plan

rows.source_ko: 14. 식품등에 대한 시정명령 등 행정제재 총괄
rows.text_en: 14. Overview of Administrative Sanctions, Including Correction Orders, Regarding Food, etc.

rows.source_ko: 15. 식품등 검사명령 제도 운영
rows.text_en: 15. Operation of the Food Inspection Order System

rows.source_ko: 16. 식품의약품안전처 소속 식품위생감시원의 임면 및 교육
rows.text_en: 16. Appointment, Dismissal, and Training of Food Hygiene Inspectors under the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety

rows.source_ko: 17. 소비자식품위생감시원 제도의 운영 총괄
rows.text_en: 17. Overall Management of the Consumer Food Hygiene Inspector System
18. Deleted <February 28, 2022>
19. Deleted <December 11, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 20. 국제회의 및 국제행사 등에 제공되는 식음료 안전관리 지원
rows.text_en: 20. Support for food and beverage safety management provided at international conferences and events, etc.

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 식중독예방과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Food Poisoning Prevention Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 식중독예방종합대책의 수립 및 시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and Implementation of Comprehensive Measures for Food Poisoning Prevention

rows.source_ko: 2. 범정부 식중독종합대응협의체 운영
rows.text_en: 2. Operation of the Pan-Government Comprehensive Food Poisoning Response Council

rows.source_ko: 3. 식중독 예방 교육ㆍ홍보 및 평가
rows.text_en: 3. Food poisoning prevention education, promotion, and evaluation

rows.text_en: 11. The Head of the Hazardous Substances Standards Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 21, 2017; Aug. 31, 2020>

rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of a comprehensive plan regarding the setting of standards and specifications and the operation, etc., of food additives, equipment, containers, and packaging (hereinafter referred to as “equipment, etc.”), and sterilizing and disinfecting agents for equipment, etc.

rows.source_ko: 제10조(수입식품안전정책국) ① 수입식품안전정책국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Import Food Safety Policy Bureau) ① The Director of the Import Food Safety Policy Bureau shall be appointed from among general civil servants, health research officers, or industrial research officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 수입식품안전정책국에 수입식품정책과ㆍ현지실사과ㆍ수입검사관리과ㆍ수입유통안전과 및 디지털수입안전기획팀을 두되, 수입식품정책과장ㆍ현지실사과장ㆍ수입검사관리과장 및 수입유통안전과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 수석전문관으로 보하고, 디지털수입안전기획팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ식품위생사무관ㆍ수의사무관ㆍ약무사무관ㆍ의료기술사무관ㆍ전산사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2021. 6. 30., 2023. 6. 1., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Import Food Safety Policy Bureau shall be established with the Import Food Policy Division, On-site Inspection Division, Import Inspection Management Division, Import Distribution Safety Division, and the Digital Import Safety Planning Team; provided that the heads of the Import Food Policy Division, On-site Inspection Division, Import Inspection Management Division, and Import Distribution Safety Division shall be appointed as Deputy Directors, Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, or Chief Specialist, and the head of the Digital Import Safety Planning Team shall be appointed as Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, Food Hygiene Officer, Veterinary Officer, Pharmaceutical Officer, Medical Technology Officer, Computer Science Officer, or Administrative Officer. <Amended June 30, 2021; June 1, 2023; August 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 수입식품정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2023. 6. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Imported Food Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended June 1, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 수입식품등 안전관리 종합계획 수립 및 제도개선
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of a Comprehensive Plan for Safety Management of Imported Foods, etc. and Improvement of Systems

rows.source_ko: 2. 새로운 제조방법 또는 원료를 이용한 식품(이하 “신소재식품”이라 한다), 유전자재조합 식품등(기구 및 용기ㆍ포장을 제외한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다) 및 식품용 유전자변형생물체의 안전관리에 관한 종합계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of a comprehensive plan for the safety management of foods using new manufacturing methods or raw materials (hereinafter referred to as “new material foods”), genetically modified foods, etc. (excluding equipment and containers/packaging; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph), and genetically modified organisms for food use

rows.source_ko: 3. 수입식품등 안전관리 법령 및 고시의 제정ㆍ개정
rows.text_en: 3. Enactment and Amendment of Laws and Notifications on Safety Management of Imported Foods, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 수입식품영업자에 대한 교육명령 및 위생교육에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning education orders and hygiene education for food import business operators

rows.source_ko: 5. 수입식품등에 관한 통계 분석ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 5. Statistical Analysis and Management of Imported Foods, etc.
6. Deleted <December 11, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 7. 수출 식품등 안전관리 지원
rows.text_en: 7. Support for Safety Management of Exported Foods, etc.

rows.source_ko: 8. 수입식품등의 사건ㆍ사고 대응 총괄
rows.text_en: 8. Overall Response to Incidents and Accidents Related to Imported Foods, etc.

rows.source_ko: 9. 수입식품등의 영업등록 관련 업무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 9. Overall management of business registration related to imported food products, etc.

rows.source_ko: 10. 수입식품등의 수입중단조치 및 해제조치에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning measures to suspend and lift imports of imported food products, etc.

rows.source_ko: 11. 수입식품등 안전 관련 국제 협력 업무
rows.text_en: 11. International cooperation affairs regarding the safety of imported food, etc.

rows.source_ko: 12. 수입식품등 관련 법인 단체 운영ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 12. Operation and Management of Corporations and Organizations Related to Imported Foods, etc.

rows.source_ko: 13. 그 밖에 국내 다른 과 및 팀의 주관에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other domestic divisions and teams

rows.source_ko: ④ 현지실사과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the On-site Inspection Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 식품등을 대한민국에 수출하는 국가(이하 “수출국”이라 한다)에 있는 제조업소 현지 안전관리 종합계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of a comprehensive on-site safety management plan for manufacturing facilities located in countries that export food products, etc. to the Republic of Korea (hereinafter referred to as the “exporting country”)

rows.source_ko: 2. 축산물 수입 관련 위생 및 안전 실태조사
rows.text_en: 2. Survey on Hygiene and Safety Status Related to Livestock Product Imports

rows.source_ko: 3. 수산물 수입 위험평가 총괄 및 조정
rows.text_en: 3. Overall management and coordination of fisheries product import risk assessment

rows.source_ko: 4. 수출국 제조ㆍ가공업소 조사ㆍ평가 기준 및 기법 개발
rows.text_en: 4. Development of Survey and Evaluation Standards and Techniques for Manufacturing and Processing Businesses in Exporting Countries

rows.source_ko: 5. 수출국 제조ㆍ가공업소 위생관리 실태 조사ㆍ평가
rows.text_en: 5. Survey and Evaluation of Hygiene Management Status of Manufacturing and Processing Establishments in Exporting Countries

rows.source_ko: 6. 해외식품 위생평가기관의 지정ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 6. Designation and Management of Overseas Food Hygiene Assessment Agencies

rows.source_ko: 7. 해외우수제조업소, 우수수입업소, 해외제조업소 및 해외작업장의 등록ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 7. Registration and Management of Excellent Overseas Manufacturers, Excellent Importers, Overseas Manufacturers, and Overseas Workplaces

rows.source_ko: 8. 부적합 판정 수입식품등에 대한 원인규명 및 해외 현지조사
rows.text_en: 8. Identification of causes and overseas on-site investigations regarding imported food products, etc. deemed non-compliant

rows.source_ko: 9. 주문자상표부착방식으로 수입되는 식품등의 수출국 제조업소 현지실사 관리
rows.text_en: 9. Management of on-site inspections of manufacturers in exporting countries for food products imported under the Private Equity Contract (OEM) method

rows.source_ko: 10. 해외 현지 민간시험ㆍ검사기관 설립 지원 및 관리
rows.text_en: 10. Support and Management of Establishment of Local Private Testing and Inspection Agencies Overseas

rows.source_ko: 11. 축산물 수입위생평가에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning the import hygiene evaluation of livestock products

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 수입검사관리과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 6. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Import Inspection Management Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended June 30, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 수입식품등에 대한 무작위표본검사 계획 수립 및 조정ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, coordination, and management of plans for random sample inspections of imported food products, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 위해정보 등에 따른 수입식품등 검사항목 지정 등 검사 업무의 조정ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 2. Coordination and management of inspection tasks, such as designation of inspection items for imported food, etc., based on risk information, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. 수입식품영업자에 대한 검사명령 제도 운영
rows.text_en: 3. Operation of the Inspection Order System for Imported Food Business Operators

rows.source_ko: 4. 수입식품영업자 구분관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the classification management of food import business operators

rows.source_ko: 5. 수입식품등 검사에 관한 해외 정보의 수집
rows.text_en: 5. Collection of overseas information regarding the inspection of imported food, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. 수입식품등에 대한 신고수리보류조치 등 수입검사 제도 운영
rows.text_en: 6. Operation of the import inspection system, including measures to suspend acceptance of declarations for imported food products, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 자사제조용 수입원료의 용도변경 승인 총괄
rows.text_en: 7. Overview of Approvals for Change of Use of Imported Raw Materials for In-House Manufacturing

rows.source_ko: 8. 수입식품등 차등검사를 위한 구분기준 설정
rows.text_en: 8. Establishment of classification criteria for differential inspection of imported food, etc.

rows.source_ko: 9. 수입식품등의 검사결과와 우수수입업자 공개
rows.text_en: 9. Disclosure of Inspection Results and Excellent Importers for Imported Foods, etc.

rows.source_ko: 10. 지방식품의약품안전청 및 수입식품검사소의 수입검사 관련 업무 지휘ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 10. Direction and supervision of import inspection-related duties of Regional Food and Drug Administrations and Import Food Inspection Offices
⑥ The Head of the Import and Distribution Safety Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 11, 2018; May 8, 2020; Dec. 30, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 수입식품등(주류는 제외한다) 유통관리 계획 수립운영
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and operation of distribution management plans for imported food products, etc. (excluding alcoholic beverages).

rows.source_ko: 2. 유통이력추적관리 대상 수입식품등 선정
rows.text_en: 2. Selection of Imported Foods, etc. Subject to Distribution Traceability Management

rows.source_ko: 3. 수입식품등 유통이력추적관리 세부기준 제정ㆍ개정
rows.text_en: 3. Enactment and Amendment of Detailed Standards for Distribution Traceability Management of Imported Foods, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 수입식품등 유통이력추적관리 등록 및 등록취소 기준 설정
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment of criteria for registration and cancellation of registration for the traceability management of imported food products

rows.source_ko: 5. 유통이력추적 기준 준수 여부 등에 대한 조사평가 총괄
rows.text_en: 5. Overall management of investigations and evaluations regarding compliance with traceability standards, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. 수입식품등의 유통이력추적관리 정보시스템 구축ㆍ관리의 위탁
rows.text_en: 6. Entrustment of the establishment and management of the distribution history tracking information system for imported food products, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 수입식품등의 유통이력추적관리에 관한 교육ㆍ홍보 등의 위탁
rows.text_en: 7. Entrustment of education, promotion, etc. regarding the traceability management of imported food products

rows.source_ko: 8. 수입식품등(주류는 제외한다)의 수거 및 검사계획 수립ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 8. Establishment and management of collection and inspection plans for imported food products, etc. (excluding alcoholic beverages)

rows.source_ko: 9. 수입식품등(주류는 제외한다)의 단속계획 수립, 회수 관리, 이물 조사, 행정제재 등 총괄
rows.text_en: 9. Overall management of enforcement plans, recall management, foreign substance investigation, administrative sanctions, etc. regarding imported food products (excluding alcoholic beverages).

rows.source_ko: 10. 수입식품등(주류는 제외한다) 영업자의 위반사실 공표
rows.text_en: 10. Publication of violations by business operators of imported food products, etc. (excluding alcoholic beverages)

rows.source_ko: 11. 수입식품등(주류는 제외한다)의 사건ㆍ사고 대응
rows.text_en: 11. Response to incidents and accidents involving imported food products, etc. (excluding alcoholic beverages)

rows.source_ko: 12. 「수입식품안전관리 특별법」에 따른 수입절차를 거치지 아니한 수입식품등(주류는 제외한다) 안전관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Matters concerning the safety management of imported food, etc. (excluding alcoholic beverages) that have not undergone import procedures under the Special Act on the Safety Management of Imported Food

rows.source_ko: 13. 부적합 수입식품등(주류는 제외한다) 긴급통보 운영ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 13. Operation and Management of Emergency Notification for Non-compliant Imported Foods, etc. (Excluding Alcoholic Beverages)

rows.source_ko: 14. 수입식품등에 대한 신고포상금 운영
rows.text_en: 14. Operation of the reward system for reporting imported food products, etc.

rows.source_ko: 15. 식품용 유전자변형생물체에 대한 수입승인, 생산승인, 취급관리기준 운영 및 위해방지를 위한 조치
rows.text_en: 15. Import approval, production approval, operation of handling management standards, and measures for preventing hazards regarding genetically modified organisms for food

rows.source_ko: 16. 식품 용도로 수입신고를 하지 않은 농수산물에 대한 사후관리
rows.text_en: 16. Post-import management of agricultural and fishery products not declared for food use

rows.source_ko: 17. 「수입식품안전관리 특별법」에 따른 직접구매 해외식품등(이하 “직접구매 해외식품등”이라 한다)의 검사 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 17. Overall management of inspection duties for directly purchased overseas food, etc. (hereinafter referred to as “directly purchased overseas food, etc.”) pursuant to the Special Act on the Safety Management of Imported Foods.

rows.source_ko: 18. 직접구매 해외식품등의 위해정보 수집 및 관리
rows.text_en: 18. Collection and Management of Hazard Information on Directly Purchased Overseas Food Products

rows.source_ko: 19. 직접구매 해외식품등에 대한 국내 반입차단 대상 원료 또는 성분의 지정 및 지정해제에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 19. Matters concerning the designation and de-designation of raw materials or ingredients subject to domestic import bans for directly purchased overseas food products, etc.

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 디지털수입안전기획팀장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2021. 6. 30., 2023. 6. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Digital Import Safety Planning Team shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly established Jun. 30, 2021; Jun. 1, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 인공지능 기반 수입식품등 자동 검사체계 구축에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the establishment of an AI-based automated inspection system for imported food, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 수입식품등 디지털 검사를 위한 정보 수집ㆍ관리ㆍ분석에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the collection, management, and analysis of information for digital inspection of imported food, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. 수입식품등 분야 인공지능 활용 모형 개발 및 연구에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the development and research of artificial intelligence utilization models in the field of imported foods, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 수입식품통합정보시스템 구축 및 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the establishment and operation of the Integrated Information System for Imported Food
[Wholly Amended Mar. 21, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제11조(식품소비안전국) ① 식품소비안전국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Food Consumption Safety Bureau) ① The Director of the Food Consumption Safety Bureau shall be appointed from among general civil servants, health research officers, or industrial research officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 식품소비안전국에 식생활영양안전정책과ㆍ축산물안전정책과ㆍ농수산물안전정책과 및 건강기능식품정책과를 두되, 식생활영양안전정책과장ㆍ축산물안전정책과장 및 농수산물안전정책과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 수석전문관으로, 건강기능식품정책과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ공업연구관 또는 수석전문관으로 보한다. <개정 2020. 1. 9., 2020. 8. 31., 2020. 12. 31., 2023. 6. 1., 2023. 8. 30., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Food Consumption Safety Bureau shall establish the Dietary Nutrition Safety Policy Division, the Livestock Product Safety Policy Division, the Agricultural and Fishery Product Safety Policy Division, and the Health Functional Food Policy Division; provided that the heads of the Dietary Nutrition Safety Policy Division, the Livestock Product Safety Policy Division, and the Agricultural and Fishery Product Safety Policy Division shall be appointed as Deputy Director-General, Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, or Senior Specialist, and the head of the Health Functional Food Policy Division shall be appointed as Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Health Research Officer, Industrial Research Officer, or Senior Specialist. <Amended Jan. 9, 2020; Aug. 31, 2020; Dec. 31, 2020; Jun. 1, 2023; Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 식생활영양안전정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2018. 12. 11.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Food and Nutrition Safety Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 11, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 어린이 식생활안전관리, 식품영양 안전에 관한 정책 개발 및 제도개선
rows.text_en: 1. Policy development and institutional improvement regarding children's dietary safety management and food and nutrition safety

rows.source_ko: 2. 어린이 식생활안전관리, 식품영양 안전 정책 및 종합계획의 수립 및 총괄
rows.text_en: 2. Management of children's dietary safety, establishment and overall management of food and nutrition safety policies and comprehensive plans

rows.source_ko: 3. 「어린이 식생활안전관리 특별법」의 개정 및 운영
rows.text_en: 3. Amendment and Operation of the Special Act on the Management of Food Safety for Children

rows.source_ko: 4. 어린이 식품안전보호구역 및 우수판매업소 지정제도 운영 및 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Operation and Management of the Child Food Safety Protection Zone and Excellent Sales Establishment Designation System

rows.source_ko: 5. 시ㆍ군ㆍ구(자치구를 말한다) 식생활 안전ㆍ영양수준 평가 제도의 운영
rows.text_en: 5. Operation of the Food Safety and Nutrition Level Assessment System for Cities, Counties, and Districts (referring to autonomous districts)

rows.source_ko: 6. 어린이 식생활 안전 지수 조사
rows.text_en: 6. Survey on Children's Dietary Safety Index

rows.source_ko: 제12조(의약품안전국) ① 의약품안전국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2019. 5. 15., 2020. 8. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Drug Safety Bureau) ① The Director of the Drug Safety Bureau shall be appointed from among general civil servants, health research officers, or industrial research officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of such position shall be Grade B. <Amended May 15, 2019; August 31, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 「식품의약품안전처와 그 소속기관 직제」 제15조제1항에 따라 의약품안전국장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 마약안전기획관으로 하며, 마약안전기획관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보하되 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 보한다. <신설 2020. 8. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 15 , Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety and Its Affiliated Agencies,” the advisory body placed under the Director General of the Drug Safety Bureau shall be the Director General of Narcotics Safety Planning; the Director General of Narcotics Safety Planning shall be appointed from among general civil servants, health research officers, or industrial research officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. <Newly added Aug. 31, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ③ 마약안전기획관은 「식품의약품안전처와 그 소속기관 직제」 제15조제3항제35호부터 제51호까지의 사항에 관하여 국장을 보좌한다. <신설 2020. 8. 31.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Director General for Narcotics Safety Planning assists the Director General with respect to matters under Subparagraphs 35 through 51 of Article 15, Paragraph 3 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety and Its Affiliated Agencies.” <Newly added Aug. 31, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ④ 의약품안전국에 의약품정책과ㆍ의약품허가총괄과ㆍ의약품관리과ㆍ의약품품질과ㆍ임상정책과ㆍ의약품안전평가과ㆍ의약품관리지원팀ㆍ마약정책과ㆍ마약관리과 및 마약예방재활팀을 두며, 의약품정책과장ㆍ의약품관리과장ㆍ의약품품질과장ㆍ임상정책과장ㆍ의약품안전평가과장ㆍ마약정책과장 및 마약관리과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 의약품허가총괄과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로, 의약품관리지원팀장 및 마약예방재활팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ식품위생사무관ㆍ수의사무관ㆍ약무사무관ㆍ의료기술사무관ㆍ전산사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2019. 5. 15., 2020. 8. 31., 2023. 6. 1., 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 3. 7., 2024. 5. 7.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Drug Safety Bureau shall have the Drug Policy Division, Drug Licensing Division, Drug Management Division, Drug Quality Division, Clinical Policy Division, Drug Safety Evaluation Division, Drug Management Support Team, Narcotics Policy Division, Narcotics Management Division, and Narcotics Prevention and Rehabilitation Team. The heads of the Drug Policy Division, Drug Management Division, Drug Quality Division, Clinical Policy Division, Drug Safety Evaluation Division, Narcotics Policy Division, and Narcotics Management Division shall be appointed as Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary; the head of the Drug Licensing Division shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Health Research Officer, or Industrial Research Officer; and the heads of the Drug Management Support Team and Narcotics Prevention and Rehabilitation Team shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Food Hygiene Officer, Veterinary Officer, Pharmaceutical Officer, Medical Technology Officer, Computer Officer, or Administrative Officer. <Amended May 15, 2019; Aug. 31, 2020; June 1, 2023; Aug. 30, 2023; March 7, 2024; May 7, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 의약품정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 5. 7.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Pharmaceutical Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended May 7, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 의약품의 안전관리에 관한 정책 개발(식품의약품안전처 소관으로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Development of policies regarding the safety management of pharmaceuticals (limited to those under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety)

rows.source_ko: 2. 의약품ㆍ마약류ㆍ화장품ㆍ의약외품ㆍ인체조직ㆍ의료기기에 대한 안전관리 정책의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management and coordination of safety management policies for pharmaceuticals, narcotics, cosmetics, quasi-pharmaceuticals, human tissues, and medical devices

rows.source_ko: 3. 중앙행정기관, 지방자치단체, 공공기관, 기업, 단체 등과의 의약품안전정보 연계ㆍ통합 및 활용 정책 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and coordination of policies for the linkage, integration, and utilization of drug safety information with central administrative agencies, local governments, public institutions, companies, organizations, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 의약품안전정보 서비스 제공, 데이터 표준화 및 활용에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the provision of drug safety information services, data standardization, and utilization

rows.source_ko: 5. 의약품통합정보시스템의 구축 및 운영 총괄
rows.text_en: 5. Overall management of the establishment and operation of the Integrated Pharmaceutical Information System

rows.source_ko: 6. 의약품통합정보시스템의 운영 위탁기관 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Management of entrusted agencies for the operation of the Integrated Pharmaceutical Information System

rows.source_ko: 7. 의약품통합정보시스템의 개인정보 보호 및 보안 대책에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning personal information protection and security measures of the Integrated Pharmaceutical Information System

rows.source_ko: 8. 의약품 소비자정보 관리
rows.text_en: 8. Management of Pharmaceutical Consumer Information

rows.source_ko: 9. 의약품과 의약외품 및 의료기기가 물리적ㆍ화학적 방법으로 결합된 제품(이하 “융복합의료제품”이라 한다)의 정책 총괄
rows.text_en: 9. Overall policy regarding products in which pharmaceuticals, quasi-pharmaceuticals, and medical devices are combined by physical or chemical methods (hereinafter referred to as “convergence medical products”)

rows.source_ko: 10. 의약품 표준제조기준에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning standard manufacturing criteria for pharmaceuticals

rows.source_ko: 11. 의약품에 관한 법령 및 고시의 제정ㆍ개정(식품의약품안전처 소관으로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 11. Enactment and amendment of laws and notices concerning pharmaceuticals (limited to those under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety)

rows.source_ko: 12. 의약품 관련 통합 공고의 개정 지원
rows.text_en: 12. Support for the Revision of Integrated Announcements Related to Pharmaceuticals

rows.source_ko: 13. 희귀의약품(「식품의약품안전처와 그 소속기관 직제」 제16조제3항제1호에 따른 바이오의약품등을 포함한다)의 지정 및 한국희귀ㆍ필수의약품센터의 지원ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 13. Designation of orphan drugs ( including biopharmaceuticals, etc. pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 1 of the "Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety and Its Affiliated Agencies" ) and support and supervision of the Korea Center for Rare and Essential Medicines

rows.source_ko: 14. 의약품 개발 기반의 조성을 위한 지원
rows.text_en: 14. Support for establishing a foundation for pharmaceutical development

rows.source_ko: 15. 중앙약사심의위원회 운영
rows.text_en: 15. Operation of the Central Pharmaceutical Affairs Deliberation Committee

rows.source_ko: 16. 의약품 허가제도, 의약품 분류 및 원료의약품 등록 관련 정책 개발 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 16. Development and overall coordination of policies related to the drug approval system, drug classification, and active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) registration

rows.source_ko: 17. 생물학적 동등성 시험 제도 운영
rows.text_en: 17. Operation of the Bioequivalence Testing System

rows.source_ko: 18. 의약품의 수출 확대 지원
rows.text_en: 18. Support for Expanding Pharmaceutical Exports

rows.source_ko: 19. 대한민국약전 등 의약품 기준ㆍ규격(생약 부분은 제외한다)의 제정ㆍ개정
rows.text_en: 19. Enactment and revision of standards and specifications for pharmaceuticals (excluding the herbal medicine portion), such as the Korean Pharmacopoeia

rows.source_ko: 20. 약국 및 의료기관 조제실제제 범위에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 20. Matters concerning the scope of preparations in pharmacies and medical institution dispensing rooms

rows.source_ko: 21. 한국의약품안전관리원 지원 및 감독
rows.text_en: 21. Support and supervision by the Korea Institute of Drug Safety and Management

rows.source_ko: 22. 그 밖에 국 내 다른 과 및 팀의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 22. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other domestic divisions and teams

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 의약품허가총괄과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2024. 5. 7.>

rows.source_ko: 1. 의약품(「식품의약품안전처와 그 소속기관 직제」 제16조제3항제1호에 따른 바이오의약품등은 제외한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다) 제조판매품목ㆍ수입품목의 허가
rows.text_en: 1. Approval for the manufacture and sale or import of pharmaceutical products ( excluding biopharmaceuticals, etc. pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety and its Affiliated Agencies” ; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph).

rows.source_ko: 10. 원료의약품의 등록에 관한 사항

rows.text_en: 11. Handling of civil complaints regarding the scope of preparations in pharmacies and medical institution dispensing rooms

rows.source_ko: 12. 의약품 허가ㆍ신고 사전 검토제 총괄
rows.text_en: 12. Overview of the Pre-review System for Drug Approval and Notification

rows.source_ko: 13. 의약품 및 바이오의약품등(「식품의약품안전처와 그 소속기관 직제」 제16조제3항제1호에 따른 바이오의약품등을 말한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다)에 대한 허가ㆍ특허 관리
rows.text_en: 13. Management of licensing and patents for pharmaceuticals and biopharmaceuticals, etc. ( referring to biopharmaceuticals, etc. pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety and its Affiliated Agencies” ; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph)

rows.text_en: 15. Registration and management of patent lists for pharmaceuticals and biopharmaceuticals, etc., and operation of related systems

rows.source_ko: 제14조(의료기기안전국) ① 의료기기안전국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Medical Device Safety Bureau) ① The Director of the Medical Device Safety Bureau shall be appointed from among general civil servants, health research officers, or industrial research officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 의료기기안전국에 의료기기정책과ㆍ혁신진단기기정책과ㆍ디지털의료제품지원총괄과ㆍ의료기기허가과ㆍ의료기기관리과 및 의료기기안전평가과를 두되, 의료기기정책과장ㆍ디지털의료제품지원총괄과장ㆍ의료기기관리과장 및 의료기기안전평가과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 혁신진단기기정책과장 및 의료기기허가과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2015. 1. 9., 2021. 2. 26., 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 5. 7., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Medical Device Safety Bureau shall have the Medical Device Policy Division, the Innovative Diagnostic Device Policy Division, the Digital Medical Product Support Division, the Medical Device Licensing Division, the Medical Device Management Division, and the Medical Device Safety Evaluation Division; provided that the heads of the Medical Device Policy Division, the Digital Medical Product Support Division, the Medical Device Management Division, and the Medical Device Safety Evaluation Division shall be appointed as Deputy Director-General, Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, or Senior Secretary, and the heads of the Innovative Diagnostic Device Policy Division and the Medical Device Licensing Division shall be appointed as Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, Health Research Officer, or Industrial Research Officer. <Amended Jan. 9, 2015; Feb. 26, 2021; Aug. 30, 2023; May 7, 2024; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제15조(식품의약품안전평가원) ① 원장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Korea Food and Drug Safety Evaluation Institute) ① The Director shall be appointed from among general civil servants, health research officers, or industrial research officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: ② 식품의약품안전평가원에 운영지원과ㆍ기획조정과ㆍ사전상담과ㆍ신속심사과 및 임상심사과를 두되, 운영지원과장은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 기획조정과장ㆍ사전상담과장ㆍ신속심사과장 및 임상심사과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2015. 5. 29., 2020. 8. 31., 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 3. 7., 2024. 10. 7.>
rows.text_en: ② The Institute of Food and Drug Safety Evaluation shall establish the Operations Support Division, Planning and Coordination Division, Pre-consultation Division, Expedited Review Division, and Clinical Review Division; provided that the Head of the Operations Support Division shall be appointed as a Senior Secretary for Science and Technology or a Senior Secretary, and the Heads of the Planning and Coordination Division, Pre-consultation Division, Expedited Review Division, and Clinical Review Division shall be appointed as Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, Health Research Officer, or Industrial Research Officer. <Amended May 29, 2015; Aug. 31, 2020; Aug. 30, 2023; Mar. 7, 2024; Oct. 7, 2024>
