rows.source_ko: 3. 바이오의약품의 임상시험계획서 및 비임상시험성적에 관한 자료 심사(백신 및 첨단바이오의약품의 비임상시험성적에 관한 자료 심사는 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Review of clinical trial protocols and non-clinical trial results data for biopharmaceuticals (excluding review of non-clinical trial results data for vaccines and advanced biopharmaceuticals)

rows.source_ko: 4. 바이오의약품의 임상시험계획서 및 비임상시험성적에 관한 자료 사전검토(백신 및 첨단바이오의약품의 비임상시험성적에 관한 자료 사전검토는 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 4. Prior review of clinical trial protocols and non-clinical trial results data for biopharmaceuticals (excluding prior review of non-clinical trial results data for vaccines and advanced biopharmaceuticals)

rows.source_ko: 5. 생약제제 및 한약제제의 임상시험계획서 및 비임상시험성적에 관한 자료 심사
rows.text_en: 5. Review of data regarding clinical trial protocols and non-clinical trial results of herbal and traditional Korean medicine preparations

rows.source_ko: 6. 생약제제 및 한약제제의 임상시험계획서 및 비임상시험성적에 관한 자료 사전검토
rows.text_en: 6. Preliminary review of clinical trial protocols and non-clinical trial results for herbal and traditional Korean medicine preparations

rows.source_ko: 7. 의료기기의 임상시험계획서 심사 지원
rows.text_en: 7. Support for the Review of Medical Device Clinical Trial Protocols

rows.source_ko: 8. 임상시험계획서 및 임상통계자료 심사 관련 지침서ㆍ해설서의 제정ㆍ개정
rows.text_en: 8. Enactment and revision of guidelines and explanatory documents regarding the review of clinical trial protocols and clinical statistical data

rows.source_ko: 9. 임상통계자료 심사
rows.text_en: 9. Review of clinical statistical data
[Wholly revised Mar. 7, 2024]
Article 18-4 Deleted <October 7, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제19조(식품위해평가부) ① 식품위해평가부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ공업연구관 또는 농업연구관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Food Risk Assessment Department) ① The Head of the Food Risk Assessment Department shall be appointed from among general civil servants, health research officers, industrial research officers, or agricultural research officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 식품위해평가부에 식품위해평가과ㆍ잔류물질과ㆍ오염물질과ㆍ미생물과ㆍ첨가물포장과ㆍ영양기능연구과ㆍ신종유해물질과 및 신소재식품과를 두되, 식품위해평가과장ㆍ잔류물질과장ㆍ오염물질과장ㆍ미생물과장ㆍ첨가물포장과장ㆍ영양기능연구과장 및 신종유해물질과장은 보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로, 신소재식품과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2015. 1. 9., 2020. 8. 31., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Department of Food Risk Assessment shall have the Food Risk Assessment Division, Residue Division, Contaminant Division, Microbiology Division, Additives & Packaging Division, Nutrition & Function Research Division, Emerging Hazardous Substances Division, and Emerging Food Materials Division; provided that the heads of the Food Risk Assessment Division, Residue Division, Contaminant Division, Microbiology Division, Additives & Packaging Division, Nutrition & Function Research Division, and Emerging Hazardous Substances Division shall be appointed as Health Research Officers or Industrial Research Officers, and the head of the Emerging Food Materials Division shall be appointed as a Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Health Research Officer, or Industrial Research Officer. <Amended Jan. 9, 2015; Aug. 31, 2020; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 식품위해평가과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2015. 1. 9.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Food Risk Assessment Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jan. 9, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. 식품등의 위해평가에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning risk assessment of food, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 위해정보 전달기술 및 인체안전 권고치 설정 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on Hazard Information Delivery Technology and Establishment of Recommended Human Safety Values

rows.source_ko: 3. 위해평가의 수학적 모델 및 위해요소의 용량반응 평가 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Mathematical Models of Risk Assessment and Dose-Response Assessment of Risk Factors

rows.source_ko: 4. 유해물질의 인체 모니터링 및 역학조사
rows.text_en: 4. Human Monitoring and Epidemiological Investigation of Hazardous Substances

rows.source_ko: 5. 인체노출평가기술ㆍ인체노출인자 및 생체지표물질의 개발ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 5. Development and Research of Human Exposure Assessment Technologies, Human Exposure Factors, and Biomarkers

rows.source_ko: 6. 유해물질의 민감군 및 위해발생 노출량의 규명 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Study on Identifying Sensitive Groups and Risk-Causing Exposure Levels of Hazardous Substances

rows.source_ko: 7. 내분비계장애물질의 시험ㆍ연구 및 인체영향과의 상관성 연구
rows.text_en: 7. Testing and research on endocrine disruptors and studies on correlations with human health effects

rows.source_ko: 8. 내분비계장애물질 평가에 관한 시험법 개발 등 국내외 기술협력
rows.text_en: 8. Domestic and international technical cooperation, including the development of test methods for the evaluation of endocrine disruptors

rows.source_ko: 12. 안전사고 등 긴급대응을 위한 위해평가
rows.text_en: 12. Risk assessment for emergency response to safety accidents, etc.

rows.source_ko: 13. 과학적 위해평가를 위한 지침서 및 해설서 개발
rows.text_en: 13. Development of Guidelines and Commentary for Scientific Risk Assessment

rows.source_ko: 14. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 위해평가 지원 및 위해평가기법 교육
rows.text_en: 14. Support for Risk Assessment of Food, Drugs, etc., and Training on Risk Assessment Techniques

rows.source_ko: 15. 그 밖에 부내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 15. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other divisions within the department

rows.source_ko: ④ 잔류물질과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Residual Substances Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 식품등에 잔류하는 농약의 위해평가 및 시험 방법 개발
rows.text_en: 1. Risk Assessment and Development of Test Methods for Pesticide Residues in Food and Other Products

rows.source_ko: 2. 식품등에 잔류하는 동물용의약품의 위해평가 및 시험법 개발
rows.text_en: 2. Risk Assessment and Development of Test Methods for Veterinary Drug Residues in Food and Other Products

rows.source_ko: 3. 식품등에 잔류하는 화학물질의 모니터링 및 노출실태조사
rows.text_en: 3. Monitoring of chemical substances remaining in food and other products and investigation of exposure status

rows.source_ko: 4. 식품등의 일반성분규격 시험 방법 개발 및 검정
rows.text_en: 4. Development and Verification of Test Methods for General Composition Standards of Foods, etc.

rows.source_ko: 5. 축산물의 이화학ㆍ생화학에 관한 시험ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 5. Testing and research on the physicochemical and biochemical aspects of livestock products

rows.source_ko: 6. 농산물의 유해물질 분석방법에 대한 연구개발 및 보급
rows.text_en: 6. Research, development, and dissemination of analytical methods for harmful substances in agricultural products

rows.source_ko: 7. 생산단계 농산물 유해물질 잔류허용기준 연구
rows.text_en: 7. Research on Permissible Residue Standards for Hazardous Substances in Agricultural Products at the Production Stage

rows.source_ko: 8. 수산물의 분석검사에 관한 시험ㆍ연구 및 교육에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning testing, research, and education regarding the analysis and inspection of fishery products

rows.source_ko: 9. 축산물의 위해요소(농약 및 동물용 의약품만 해당한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다)에 대한 체내대사 및 잔류성 평가ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 9. Evaluation and research on in vivo metabolism and persistence of hazardous elements in livestock products (limited to pesticides and veterinary drugs; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph)

rows.source_ko: 10. 축산물의 위해요소에 대한 잔류검사, 잔류분석법 개발 및 잔류실태의 조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 10. Residue testing for hazardous elements in livestock products, development of residue analysis methods, and investigation and research on residue status

rows.source_ko: 11. 축산물의 위해요소에 대한 잔류분석에 관한 기술 지원ㆍ교육ㆍ검사계획 수립
rows.text_en: 11. Establishment of technical support, training, and inspection plans regarding residue analysis of hazardous elements in livestock products

rows.source_ko: 12. 제1호부터 제11호까지의 사항과 관련된 연구 및 검정
rows.text_en: 12. Research and testing related to the matters in Items 1 through 11

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 오염물질과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Pollution Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 식품등의 오염물질 노출실태조사 및 위해성 평가
rows.text_en: 1. Survey on Exposure to Contaminants in Food and Other Products and Risk Assessment

rows.source_ko: 2. 식품등의 유해중금속 시험 방법 개발 및 모니터링
rows.text_en: 2. Development of testing methods for harmful heavy metals in food and other products and monitoring

rows.source_ko: 3. 식품등의 유기성오염물질의 시험 방법 개발 및 모니터링
rows.text_en: 3. Development of test methods and monitoring of organic contaminants in food, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 식품등의 곰팡이독소의 시험 방법 개발 및 모니터링
rows.text_en: 4. Development of testing methods and monitoring of mycotoxins in food, etc.

rows.source_ko: 5. 식품등의 마비성패독 등 자연독소의 시험 방법 개발 및 모니터링
rows.text_en: 5. Development of testing methods and monitoring of natural toxins, such as paralytic shellfish toxins, in food, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. 수산물, 축산물의 환경오염물질에 대한 위해성평가
rows.text_en: 6. Risk assessment of environmental pollutants in fishery and livestock products

rows.source_ko: 7. 수산물, 축산물의 방사능 검사 시험ㆍ조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 7. Testing, investigation, and research on radioactivity of fishery and livestock products

rows.source_ko: 8. 제1호부터 제7호까지의 사항과 관련된 연구 및 검정
rows.text_en: 8. Research and testing related to the matters in Items 1 through 7

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 미생물과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of Microbiology is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 식품등의 세균 등 미생물의 위해평가 및 시험법 개발
rows.text_en: 1. Risk Assessment and Development of Test Methods for Microorganisms, Including Bacteria, in Food and Other Foods

rows.source_ko: 2. 식품등의 세균 등 미생물 및 식품매개 바이러스의 실태조사
rows.text_en: 2. Survey on the Status of Microorganisms, Including Bacteria, and Foodborne Viruses in Food, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. 식품매개 바이러스의 시험 방법 개발
rows.text_en: 3. Development of Testing Methods for Foodborne Viruses

rows.source_ko: 4. 식중독 원인 미생물의 조사
rows.text_en: 4. Investigation of microorganisms causating food poisoning

rows.source_ko: 5. 식품등의 기생충 및 그 알의 시험 방법 개발
rows.text_en: 5. Development of testing methods for parasites and their eggs in food, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. 항생제 내성(耐性)의 안전관리
rows.text_en: 6. Safety Management of Antibiotic Resistance

rows.source_ko: 7. 인수공통전염병 등의 위해평가 및 검사ㆍ시험ㆍ조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 7. Risk assessment of zoonotic diseases, etc., and inspection, testing, investigation, and research

rows.source_ko: 8. 축산물의 성분규격 및 미생물 검사ㆍ시험ㆍ조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 8. Ingredient Standards and Microbiological Inspection, Testing, Investigation, and Research of Livestock Products

rows.source_ko: 9. 식육의 미생물 검사ㆍ시험ㆍ조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 9. Microbiological Inspection, Testing, Investigation, and Research of Meat

rows.source_ko: 10. 제1호부터 제9호까지의 사항과 관련된 연구 및 검정
rows.text_en: 10. Research and testing related to the matters in Items 1 through 9

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 첨가물포장과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2020. 2. 27.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Additives and Packaging Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Feb. 27, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 식품첨가물, 기구등 및 기구등의 살균ㆍ소독제에 관한 위해평가, 시험법 개발 및 검정
rows.text_en: 1. Risk assessment, development of test methods, and verification regarding food additives, equipment, etc., and sterilizers/disinfectants for equipment, etc.

rows.source_ko: 1의2. 위생용품(식품안전과 관련된 위생용품에 한한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다)에 관한 위해평가, 시험 방법 개발 및 검정
rows.text_en: 1-2. Risk assessment, development of test methods, and verification regarding sanitary products (limited to sanitary products related to food safety; hereinafter the same applies in this Article).

rows.source_ko: 2. 천연첨가물, 기구등 및 기구등의 살균ㆍ소독제에 관한 한시적 기준규격 관련 기술 검토
rows.text_en: 2. Technical Review Regarding Temporary Standards and Specifications Concerning Natural Additives, Equipment, etc., and Sterilizers/Disinfectants for Equipment, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. 위생용품의 기준ㆍ규격 기술 검토
rows.text_en: 3. Technical Review of Standards and Specifications for Sanitary Products

rows.source_ko: 4. 식품첨가물, 기구등 및 기구등의 살균ㆍ소독제에 관한 모니터링 및 노출 실태조사
rows.text_en: 4. Monitoring and Exposure Survey on Food Additives, Equipment, and Sterilizers/Disinfectants for Equipment

rows.source_ko: 4의2. 위생용품에 관한 모니터링 및 노출 실태조사
rows.text_en: 4-2. Monitoring and Exposure Survey of Sanitary Products

rows.source_ko: 5. 식품등의 식품첨가물(대한민국에서는 허용되지 아니하나 다른 나라에서는 사용이 허가된 첨가물을 포함한다) 시험 방법 개발 및 검정
rows.text_en: 5. Development of test methods and verification of food additives in food, etc. (including additives not permitted in the Republic of Korea but authorized for use in other countries)

rows.source_ko: 6. 기구등에서 유래하는 유해물질 시험 방법 개발 및 검정
rows.text_en: 6. Development and Verification of Test Methods for Hazardous Substances Derived from Equipment, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 제1호부터 제6호까지의 사항과 관련된 연구 및 검정
rows.text_en: 7. Research and testing related to the matters in Items 1 through 6
⑧ The Head of the Nutrition and Functional Research Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jan. 9, 2015; Mar. 21, 2017; Aug. 31, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 건강기능식품 위해평가 및 시험 방법 개발
rows.text_en: 1. Development of Risk Assessment and Test Methods for Health Functional Foods

rows.source_ko: 2. 건강기능식품 기준 및 규격 모니터링
rows.text_en: 2. Monitoring of Standards and Specifications for Health Functional Foods

rows.source_ko: 3. 건강기능식품 유해성분 모니터링
rows.text_en: 3. Monitoring of harmful ingredients in health functional foods

rows.source_ko: 4. 식품등(기구 또는 용기ㆍ포장은 제외한다)의 영양성분 시험 방법 개발
rows.text_en: 4. Development of testing methods for nutritional components of food products (excluding equipment or containers and packaging)

rows.source_ko: 5. 식품위해평가를 위한 식이섭취량의 조사 및 평가
rows.text_en: 5. Investigation and Evaluation of Dietary Intake for Food Risk Assessment

rows.source_ko: 6. 농수산물 및 그 가공품, 식품접객업소 음식 등의 영양표시 실태조사
rows.text_en: 6. Survey on the Status of Nutritional Labeling of Agricultural and Fishery Products, Processed Products, and Food in Food Service Establishments

rows.source_ko: 7. 대국민 식이행태 조사
rows.text_en: 7. National Survey on Dietary Behavior

rows.source_ko: 8. 식품등(기구 또는 용기ㆍ포장은 제외한다) 중 영양성분 식이노출평가 및 실태조사
rows.text_en: 8. Dietary exposure assessment and status survey of nutrient components in food products (excluding utensils or containers and packaging)

rows.source_ko: 9. 건강기능식품의 안전관리를 위한 위해평가에 관한 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 9. Technical support for risk assessment for the safety management of health functional foods

rows.source_ko: 10. 일반식품형태의 건강기능식품 인정을 위한 자료검토 및 심사
rows.text_en: 10. Review of data and examination for the recognition of health functional foods in the form of general foods

rows.source_ko: 11. 건강기능식품 기능성 원료 또는 성분의 인정을 위한 자료검토 및 심사
rows.text_en: 11. Review of data and examination for the recognition of functional ingredients or components of health functional foods

rows.source_ko: 12. 건강기능식품 및 기능성 원료 인정과 관련한 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 12. Technical support related to the recognition of health functional foods and functional ingredients

rows.source_ko: 13. 건강기능식품의 제품화를 위한 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 13. Technical support for the commercialization of health functional foods

rows.source_ko: 14. 제1호부터 제13호까지의 사항과 관련된 연구 및 검정
rows.text_en: 14. Research and testing related to the matters in Items 1 through 13

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 신종유해물질과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2020. 8. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Head of the Emerging Hazardous Substances Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Aug. 31, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 과학적 식품감시체계 연구ㆍ개발
rows.text_en: 1. Research and Development of Scientific Food Surveillance Systems

rows.source_ko: 2. 과학적 식품감시기법 개발 및 감시지침서 보급
rows.text_en: 2. Development of scientific food surveillance techniques and dissemination of surveillance guidelines

rows.source_ko: 3. 식품등의 이물 종류 및 혼입 원인 규명 지원, 식품별 이물 혼입 저감화 대책 개발
rows.text_en: 3. Support for identifying types of foreign substances and causes of contamination in food products, and development of measures to reduce foreign substance contamination for each food item

rows.source_ko: 4. 위해 식품등 긴급회수관리 시스템 개발 및 회수 관련 제도 개선 지원
rows.text_en: 4. Development of an emergency recall management system for hazardous foods, etc., and support for improvements to recall-related regulations

rows.source_ko: 5. 식품등의 신종 유해물질 위해평가 및 시험 방법 개발, 연구 및 검정
rows.text_en: 5. Risk assessment of novel hazardous substances in food, etc., and development, research, and testing of test methods

rows.source_ko: 6. 식품등의 제조ㆍ가공 과정 중 생성되는 신종 유해물질의 모니터링 및 노출 실태조사
rows.text_en: 6. Monitoring of novel hazardous substances generated during the manufacturing and processing of food and other products, and investigation of exposure status

rows.source_ko: 7. 식품등의 부정(不正)물질의 탐색ㆍ규명, 위해평가 및 시험 방법 개발
rows.text_en: 7. Discovery and identification of illicit substances in food, etc., risk assessment, and development of test methods

rows.source_ko: 8. 신속한 과학감시를 위한 현장 간이 시험 방법 개발 및 필요 장비 연구
rows.text_en: 8. Development of simplified field testing methods and research on necessary equipment for rapid scientific surveillance

rows.source_ko: 9. 유통 중인 식품등의 과학적 수거ㆍ검사 체계 및 해설서 연구 개발
rows.text_en: 9. Research and Development of a Scientific Collection and Inspection System and Guidelines for Food Products in Distribution

rows.source_ko: 10. 자발적 위생관리를 위한 식품등 취급 업종별 위생관리 해설서 및 교육교재 개발 보급
rows.text_en: 10. Development and distribution of hygiene management guides and educational materials for each food handling industry to promote voluntary hygiene management

rows.source_ko: 11. 건강기능식품의 제조 및 품질관리기준 관련 지침서 및 해설서 등 연구 개발
rows.text_en: 11. Research and development of guidelines, explanatory documents, etc. related to manufacturing and quality control standards for health functional foods

rows.source_ko: 12. 축산물의 방사선 검사 시험ㆍ조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 12. Radiation Inspection Testing, Survey, and Research of Livestock Products

rows.source_ko: 13. 방사선조사 식품등의 시험법 개발, 안전성 평가 및 관련 연구ㆍ검정
rows.text_en: 13. Development of test methods, safety evaluation, and related research and testing of irradiated foods, etc.

rows.source_ko: 14. 제1호부터 제13호까지의 사항과 관련된 연구 및 검정
rows.text_en: 14. Research and testing related to the matters in Items 1 through 13

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 신소재식품과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2015. 1. 9., 2020. 8. 31.>
rows.text_en: 10. The Head of the New Materials and Food Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly established Jan. 9, 2015; Aug. 31, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 유전자재조합 식품등(기구 또는 용기ㆍ포장을 제외한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다)의 안전성 평가 심사
rows.text_en: 1. Safety evaluation of genetically modified foods, etc. (excluding equipment or containers and packaging; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph)

rows.source_ko: 2. 신소재식품의 안전성 평가
rows.text_en: 2. Safety Evaluation of Novel Food Materials

rows.source_ko: 3. 유전자재조합 식품등에 대한 교육 및 홍보
rows.text_en: 3. Education and promotion regarding genetically modified foods, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 식품원료의 한시적 기준ㆍ규격 인정
rows.text_en: 4. Recognition of temporary standards and specifications for food ingredients

rows.source_ko: 5. 유전자재조합 식품등(기구 또는 용기ㆍ포장은 제외한다)의 시험방법 개발, 연구 및 검정
rows.text_en: 5. Development of test methods, research, and testing for genetically modified foods, etc. (excluding equipment or containers and packaging).

rows.source_ko: 6. 유전자변형 농축수산물의 시험ㆍ조사ㆍ연구 및 검정
rows.text_en: 6. Testing, investigation, research, and verification of genetically modified agricultural, livestock, and fishery products

rows.source_ko: 7. 유전자변형 농산물의 판별기술에 대한 시험ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 7. Testing and Research on Identification Technology for Genetically Modified Agricultural Products

rows.source_ko: 8. 제1호부터 제7호까지의 사항과 관련된 연구 및 검정
rows.text_en: 8. Research and testing related to the matters in Items 1 through 7

rows.source_ko: 제20조(의약품심사부) ① 의약품심사부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Drug Review Department) ① The head of the Drug Review Department shall be appointed from among general civil servants, health research officers, or industrial research officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 의약품심사부에 의약품규격과ㆍ순환신경계약품과ㆍ종양항생약품과ㆍ첨단의약품품질심사1과ㆍ첨단의약품품질심사2과 및 약효동등성과를 두되, 각 과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2020. 8. 31., 2023. 8. 30., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Department of Pharmaceutical Review shall have the Pharmaceutical Standards Division, the Circulatory and Nervous System Drugs Division, the Oncology and Antibiotics Division, the Advanced Pharmaceutical Quality Review Division 1, the Advanced Pharmaceutical Quality Review Division 2, and the Pharmacoequivalence Division; the heads of each division shall be appointed from among Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Health Research Officers, or Industrial Research Officers. <Amended Aug. 31, 2020; Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 30, 2025>
③ Deleted <2020. 8. 31.>

rows.source_ko: ④ 의약품규격과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2015. 1. 9., 2020. 8. 31.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Pharmaceutical Standards Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jan. 9, 2015; Aug. 31, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 의약품에 대한 기준ㆍ규격의 설정 지원
rows.text_en: 1. Support for the establishment of standards and specifications for pharmaceuticals

rows.source_ko: 2. 의약품에 대한 국제기구 및 선진국의 기준ㆍ규격에 관한 신규 정보의 탐색 및 비교ㆍ검토
rows.text_en: 2. Search for, comparison, and review of new information regarding standards and specifications of international organizations and developed countries for pharmaceuticals

rows.source_ko: 3. 원료의약품 등록자료 심사
rows.text_en: 3. Review of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient Registration Data

rows.source_ko: 4. 원료의약품의 품질심사
rows.text_en: 4. Quality review of active pharmaceutical ingredients

rows.source_ko: 5. 의약품 품질에 관한 자료 검토
rows.text_en: 5. Review of data regarding drug quality

rows.source_ko: 6. 소관 의약품 허가ㆍ심사 지침서 및 해설서의 제정ㆍ개정
rows.text_en: 6. Enactment and revision of guidelines and explanatory notes for the approval and review of pharmaceuticals under the jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 7. 소관 의약품에 관한 검정 및 시험분석 업무의 지원
rows.text_en: 7. Support for verification and test analysis work regarding pharmaceuticals under its jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 8. 그 밖에 부 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other divisions within the department
⑤ The Director of the Circulatory and Nervous System Drugs Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jan. 9, 2015; Aug. 31, 2020; Mar. 7, 2024; Feb. 26, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 순환계용 의약품의 안전성ㆍ유효성 심사
rows.text_en: 1. Review of safety and efficacy of circulatory system drugs

rows.source_ko: 3. 중추신경계용 의약품의 안전성ㆍ유효성 심사
rows.text_en: 3. Review of safety and efficacy of central nervous system drugs

rows.source_ko: 4. 말초신경계용 의약품의 안전성ㆍ유효성 심사
rows.text_en: 4. Review of safety and efficacy of drugs for the peripheral nervous system

rows.source_ko: 5. 감각기관계용 의약품의 안전성ㆍ유효성 심사
rows.text_en: 5. Review of safety and efficacy of medicines for the sensory system

rows.source_ko: 5의2. 마약류의 안전성ㆍ유효성 심사
rows.text_en: 5-2. Review of Safety and Efficacy of Narcotic Drugs

rows.source_ko: 6. 소관 의약품 허가ㆍ심사의 지침서 및 해설서의 제정ㆍ개정
rows.text_en: 6. Enactment and revision of guidelines and explanatory documents for the approval and review of pharmaceuticals under the jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 7. 소관 의약품에 대한 임상시험계획 심사
rows.text_en: 7. Review of clinical trial plans for relevant drugs

rows.source_ko: 8. 소관 의약품에 대한 허가ㆍ신고 후 변경자료 심사
rows.text_en: 8. Review of amendment data following approval or notification for relevant pharmaceuticals

rows.source_ko: 9. 소관 의약품에 대한 재평가 자료 심사
rows.text_en: 9. Review of re-evaluation data for pharmaceuticals under the jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 10. 소관 의약품의 심사 관련 정보공개
rows.text_en: 10. Disclosure of Information Related to the Review of Pharmaceuticals Under Jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 11. 재심사 자료 심사 및 의약품 위해성 관리계획(RMP) 이행 평가 결과보고서 검토
rows.text_en: 11. Review of re-evaluation data and report on the implementation evaluation of the Risk Management Plan (RMP)

rows.source_ko: 12. 소관 의약품에 대한 약리, 독성, 임상시험 사전검토
rows.text_en: 12. Preliminary review of pharmacology, toxicology, and clinical trials for pharmaceuticals under its jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 13. 소관 의약품으로 허가ㆍ신고된 의약품의 허가ㆍ신고 범위 외 사용에 관한 안전성ㆍ유효성 심사
rows.text_en: 13. Safety and efficacy review regarding the use of pharmaceuticals authorized or registered as pharmaceuticals within the jurisdiction outside the scope of authorization or registration
⑥ The Head of the Oncology and Antibiotics Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jan. 9, 2015; Aug. 31, 2020; Mar. 7, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 항생제의 안전성ㆍ유효성 심사
rows.text_en: 1. Review of the safety and efficacy of antibiotics

rows.source_ko: 2. 화학요법제의 안전성ㆍ유효성 심사
rows.text_en: 2. Review of safety and efficacy of chemotherapy agents

rows.source_ko: 3. 항암제의 안전성ㆍ유효성 심사
rows.text_en: 3. Review of safety and efficacy of anticancer drugs

rows.source_ko: 4. 구충제의 안전성ㆍ유효성 심사
rows.text_en: 4. Review of Safety and Efficacy of Antiparasitics

rows.source_ko: 5. 알레르기용 약의 안전성ㆍ유효성 심사
rows.text_en: 5. Review of Safety and Efficacy of Allergy Medications

rows.source_ko: 6. 방사성(放射性)의약품의 안전성ㆍ유효성 심사
rows.text_en: 6. Review of Safety and Efficacy of Radiopharmaceuticals

rows.source_ko: 7. 진단용의약품의 안전성ㆍ유효성 심사
rows.text_en: 7. Review of Safety and Efficacy of Diagnostic Drugs

rows.source_ko: 8. 소관 의약품에 대한 임상시험계획 심사
rows.text_en: 8. Review of clinical trial plans for relevant drugs

rows.source_ko: 9. 소관 의약품에 대한 허가ㆍ신고 후 변경자료 심사
rows.text_en: 9. Review of amendment data following approval or notification for relevant pharmaceuticals

rows.source_ko: 10. 소관 의약품 허가ㆍ심사의 지침서 및 해설서의 제정ㆍ개정
rows.text_en: 10. Enactment and revision of guidelines and explanatory documents for the approval and review of pharmaceuticals under the jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 11. 소관 의약품에 대한 재심사 및 재평가 자료 심사
rows.text_en: 11. Review of data for re-examination and re-evaluation of pharmaceuticals under the jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 12. 소관 의약품의 심사 관련 정보공개
rows.text_en: 12. Disclosure of Information Related to the Review of Pharmaceuticals Under Jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 14. 소관 의약품에 대한 약리, 독성, 임상시험 사전검토
rows.text_en: 14. Preliminary review of pharmacology, toxicology, and clinical trials for pharmaceuticals under its jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 15. 소화기관계용 의약품의 안전성ㆍ유효성 심사
rows.text_en: 15. Review of safety and efficacy of drugs for the digestive system

rows.source_ko: 16. 비뇨생식기관계용 의약품의 안전성ㆍ유효성 심사
rows.text_en: 16. Safety and Efficacy Review of Medicines for the Genitourinary System

rows.source_ko: 17. 호르몬제 의약품의 안전성ㆍ유효성 심사
rows.text_en: 17. Safety and Efficacy Review of Hormonal Drugs

rows.source_ko: 18. 호흡기관계용 의약품의 안전성ㆍ유효성 심사
rows.text_en: 18. Safety and Efficacy Review of Respiratory System Medicines

rows.source_ko: 19. 소관 의약품으로 허가ㆍ신고된 의약품의 허가ㆍ신고 범위 외 사용에 관한 안전성ㆍ유효성 심사
rows.text_en: 19. Safety and efficacy review regarding the use of pharmaceuticals authorized or registered as pharmaceuticals within the jurisdiction outside the scope of authorization or registration

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 첨단의약품품질심사1과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Advanced Pharmaceutical Quality Review Division 1 shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 자료제출의약품(희귀의약품 및 방사성의약품은 제외한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다)의 품질 심사
rows.text_en: 1. Quality review of data-submitted drugs (excluding orphan drugs and radiopharmaceuticals; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph)

rows.source_ko: 2. 자료제출의약품 및 그 염류 원료의약품 등록자료 심사
rows.text_en: 2. Examination of registration data for data-submitted drugs and their salts, active pharmaceutical ingredients

rows.source_ko: 3. 자료제출의약품에 대한 허가ㆍ신고 후 변경자료 품질 심사
rows.text_en: 3. Quality review of amendment data following approval or notification for data-submitted drugs

rows.source_ko: 4. 자료제출의약품 허가ㆍ심사 지침서 및 해설서의 제정ㆍ개정
rows.text_en: 4. Enactment and Revision of Guidelines and Commentary on the Approval and Review of Data-Submitted Drugs

rows.source_ko: 5. 자료제출의약품에 대한 품질 등 사전검토
rows.text_en: 5. Preliminary review of quality, etc., of data-submitted drugs

rows.source_ko: 6. 자료제출의약품의 심사 관련 정보공개
rows.text_en: 6. Disclosure of Information Related to the Review of Data-Submitted Drugs

rows.source_ko: 7. 자료제출의약품에 관한 검정 및 시험분석 업무의 지원
rows.text_en: 7. Support for verification and test analysis work regarding data-submitted pharmaceuticals

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 첨단의약품품질심사2과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Head of the Advanced Pharmaceutical Quality Review Division 2 shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly added Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 신약 및 희귀의약품의 품질 심사
rows.text_en: 1. Quality review of new drugs and orphan drugs

rows.source_ko: 2. 방사성의약품의 품질 심사
rows.text_en: 2. Quality assessment of radiopharmaceuticals

rows.source_ko: 3. 융복합 의료제품의 품질 심사
rows.text_en: 3. Quality Assessment of Convergence Medical Products

rows.source_ko: 4. 신약ㆍ희귀의약품ㆍ방사성의약품ㆍ융복합 의료제품 및 그 염류 원료의약품 등록자료 심사
rows.text_en: 4. Examination of registration data for new drugs, orphan drugs, radiopharmaceuticals, convergence medical products, and their salts and active pharmaceutical ingredients

rows.source_ko: 5. 의약품에 대한 임상시험계획서 심사(품질 심사로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 5. Review of clinical trial protocols for pharmaceuticals (limited to quality review)

rows.source_ko: 6. 신약ㆍ희귀의약품ㆍ방사성의약품ㆍ융복합 의료제품에 대한 허가ㆍ신고 후 변경자료 품질 심사
rows.text_en: 6. Quality review of post-approval or notification amendment data for new drugs, orphan drugs, radiopharmaceuticals, and convergence medical products

rows.source_ko: 7. 신약ㆍ희귀의약품ㆍ방사성의약품ㆍ융복합 의료제품에 대한 허가ㆍ심사 지침서 및 해설서의 제정ㆍ개정
rows.text_en: 7. Enactment and revision of guidelines and explanatory notes for the approval and review of new drugs, orphan drugs, radiopharmaceuticals, and convergence medical products

rows.source_ko: 8. 신약ㆍ희귀의약품ㆍ방사성의약품ㆍ융복합 의료제품에 대한 품질 등 사전검토
rows.text_en: 8. Preliminary review of quality, etc., for new drugs, orphan drugs, radiopharmaceuticals, and convergence medical products

rows.source_ko: 9. 신약ㆍ희귀의약품ㆍ방사성의약품ㆍ융복합 의료제품의 심사 관련 정보공개
rows.text_en: 9. Disclosure of Information Related to the Review of New Drugs, Orphan Drugs, Radiopharmaceuticals, and Convergence Medical Products

rows.source_ko: 10. 신약ㆍ희귀의약품ㆍ방사성의약품ㆍ융복합 의료제품에 관한 검정 및 시험분석 업무의 지원
rows.text_en: 10. Support for verification and testing analysis services regarding new drugs, orphan drugs, radiopharmaceuticals, and convergence medical products
⑨ The Director of the Pharmaceutical Equivalence Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jan. 9, 2015; Aug. 31, 2020; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 생물학적동등성시험 계획서 심사
rows.text_en: 1. Review of Bioequivalence Test Protocol

rows.source_ko: 2. 생물학적동등성시험 결과보고서 심사
rows.text_en: 2. Review of Bioequivalence Test Result Report

rows.source_ko: 3. 생물학적동등성시험 재평가 심사
rows.text_en: 3. Review of Bioequivalence Test Re-evaluation

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 의료인공지능소프트웨어과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Head of the Medical Artificial Intelligence Software Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「디지털의료제품법」 제2조제7호나목에 따른 독립형 디지털의료기기소프트웨어(이하 이 항에서 “독립형 디지털의료기기소프트웨어”라 한다)의 기술문서 심사
rows.text_en: 1. Examination of technical documents for standalone digital medical device software pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 7 , Item B of the Digital Medical Products Act (hereinafter referred to as “standalone digital medical device software” in this paragraph)

rows.source_ko: 2. 독립형 디지털의료기기소프트웨어의 임상시험 등 평가에 관한 자료 심사
rows.text_en: 2. Review of data regarding the evaluation, such as clinical trials, of standalone digital medical device software

rows.source_ko: 3. 독립형 디지털의료기기소프트웨어의 임상시험계획ㆍ임상시험계획변경ㆍ임상시험기관 외 실시 승인 심사
rows.text_en: 3. Review of approvals for clinical trial plans, clinical trial plan amendments, and implementation outside clinical trial sites for standalone digital medical device software

rows.source_ko: 4. 독립형 디지털의료기기소프트웨어의 변경관리 계획 심사에 관한 사항(인공지능기술이 적용된 경우로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the review of change management plans for standalone digital medical device software (limited to cases where artificial intelligence technology is applied)

rows.source_ko: 5. 디지털의료기기의 구성요소에 대한 성능평가에 관한 사항(인공지능 알고리즘으로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning performance evaluation of components of digital medical devices (limited to artificial intelligence algorithms)

rows.source_ko: 6. 제1호부터 제5호까지의 심사에 필요한 자료의 사전검토
rows.text_en: 6. Preliminary review of materials necessary for the examination of Items 1 through 5

rows.source_ko: 7. 독립형 디지털의료기기소프트웨어의 기준ㆍ규격 설정 및 운영 지원
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment of standards and specifications for standalone digital medical device software and support for operation

rows.source_ko: 8. 독립형 디지털의료기기소프트웨어의 기술문서 심사지침서 및 해설서 제정ㆍ개정
rows.text_en: 8. Enactment and Revision of Technical Documentation Review Guidelines and Commentary for Standalone Digital Medical Device Software

rows.source_ko: 9. 독립형 디지털의료기기소프트웨어 관련 인증업무 등 대행기관 교육에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning training for agencies regarding certification work related to standalone digital medical device software, etc.

rows.source_ko: 10. 독립형 디지털의료기기소프트웨어에 관한 시험ㆍ검사기관의 지정 및 지도ㆍ감독에 대한 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 10. Technical support for the designation and guidance and supervision of testing and inspection institutions regarding standalone digital medical device software

rows.source_ko: 11. 신개발의료기기 중 독립형 디지털의료기기소프트웨어의 기술문서 심사 등 허가 지원
rows.text_en: 11. Support for licensing, including technical documentation review, for standalone digital medical device software among newly developed medical devices

rows.source_ko: 12. 독립형 디지털의료기기소프트웨어의 재심사 및 재평가 자료 심사
rows.text_en: 12. Review of data for the re-examination and re-evaluation of standalone digital medical device software

rows.source_ko: 13. 독립형 디지털의료기기소프트웨어 수입업자(3ㆍ4등급 의료기기 수입업자만 해당한다)에 대한 제조 및 품질관리기준 심사 지원
rows.text_en: 13. Support for the review of manufacturing and quality control standards for importers of standalone digital medical device software (applicable only to importers of Class 3 and 4 medical devices)

rows.source_ko: 14. 디지털의료기기의 규제 지원 및 관리
rows.text_en: 14. Regulatory Support and Management of Digital Medical Devices

rows.source_ko: 15. 「혁신의료기기 지원 및 관리 등에 관한 규칙」 제7조제1항에 따른 혁신의료기기소프트웨어(이하 이 항에서 “혁신의료기기소프트웨어”라 한다)에 대한 우선심사 및 단계별 심사
rows.text_en: 15. Priority review and phased review of innovative medical device software (hereinafter referred to as “innovative medical device software” in this paragraph) pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the “Rules on Support and Management, etc. of Innovative Medical Devices”

rows.source_ko: 16. 혁신의료기기소프트웨어의 지정에 관한 심사 지원
rows.text_en: 16. Support for the Review of Designation of Innovative Medical Device Software

rows.source_ko: 17. 혁신의료기기소프트웨어 제조기업의 인증 및 운영
rows.text_en: 17. Certification and Operation of Innovative Medical Device Software Manufacturing Companies

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 지능형융합의료기기과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: 10. The Head of the Intelligent Convergence Medical Devices Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly established Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 하드웨어에 내장형 디지털의료기기소프트웨어를 탑재한 디지털의료기기 등(이하 이 항에서 “지능형융합의료기기”라 한다)의 기술문서 심사
rows.text_en: 1. Examination of technical documents for digital medical devices, etc. equipped with embedded digital medical device software on hardware (hereinafter referred to as “intelligent convergence medical devices” in this paragraph)

rows.source_ko: 2. 지능형융합의료기기의 임상시험자료 심사
rows.text_en: 2. Review of clinical trial data for intelligent convergence medical devices

rows.source_ko: 3. 지능형융합의료기기의 임상시험계획ㆍ임상시험계획변경 심사
rows.text_en: 3. Review of Clinical Trial Plans and Changes to Clinical Trial Plans for Intelligent Convergence Medical Devices

rows.source_ko: 4. 디지털의료기기의 구성요소에 대한 성능평가에 관한 사항(센서로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning performance evaluation of components of digital medical devices (limited to sensors)

rows.source_ko: 5. 의료기기의 사이버보안 및 디지털의료기기의 전자적 침해행위로부터의 보호 조치 자료 심사에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the review of data on cybersecurity for medical devices and protection measures against electronic infringement for digital medical devices

rows.source_ko: 6. 디지털의료기기의 사용적합성 자료 심사에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the review of usability data for digital medical devices

rows.source_ko: 7. 제1호부터 제6호까지의 심사에 필요한 자료의 사전검토
rows.text_en: 7. Preliminary review of materials necessary for the examination of Items 1 through 6

rows.source_ko: 8. 디지털융합의약품의 부분을 구성하는 디지털의료기기 심사
rows.text_en: 8. Review of digital medical devices constituting a part of digital convergence pharmaceuticals

rows.source_ko: 9. 지능형융합의료기기의 기준ㆍ규격 설정 및 운영 지원
rows.text_en: 9. Support for the establishment of standards and specifications and operation of intelligent convergence medical devices

rows.source_ko: 10. 지능형융합의료기기의 기술문서 심사지침서 및 해설서 제정ㆍ개정
rows.text_en: 10. Enactment and Revision of Technical Document Review Guidelines and Commentary for Intelligent Convergence Medical Devices

rows.source_ko: 11. 지능형융합의료기기 관련 기술문서 심사기관 교육에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning training for technical document review agencies related to intelligent convergence medical devices

rows.source_ko: 12. 지능형융합의료기기에 관한 기술문서 심사기관, 시험ㆍ검사기관의 지정 및 지도ㆍ감독에 대한 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 12. Technical support for the designation, guidance, and supervision of technical document review agencies and testing and inspection agencies regarding intelligent convergence medical devices

rows.source_ko: 13. 신개발의료기기 중 지능형융합의료기기의 기술문서 심사 등 허가 지원
rows.text_en: 13. Support for licensing, including technical document review, for intelligent convergence medical devices among newly developed medical devices

rows.source_ko: 14. 지능형융합의료기기의 재심사 및 재평가 자료 심사
rows.text_en: 14. Review of data for the re-examination and re-evaluation of intelligent convergence medical devices

rows.source_ko: 15. 지능형융합의료기기 수입업자에 대한 제조 및 품질관리기준 심사 지원(3ㆍ4등급 의료기기 수입업자만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 15. Support for the review of manufacturing and quality control standards for importers of intelligent convergence medical devices (applicable only to importers of Class 3 and 4 medical devices)

rows.source_ko: 제23조(의료제품연구부) ① 의료제품연구부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 23 (Medical Products Research Department) ① The head of the Medical Products Research Department shall be appointed from among general civil servants, health research officers, or industrial research officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 의료제품연구부에 의약품연구과ㆍ바이오의약품연구과ㆍ첨단바이오융복합연구과ㆍ생약연구과ㆍ화장품연구과 및 의료기기연구과를 두되, 각 과장은 보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2015. 1. 9., 2020. 8. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② The Department of Medical Products Research shall have the Pharmaceutical Research Division, the Biopharmaceutical Research Division, the Advanced Bio-Convergence Research Division, the Herbal Medicine Research Division, the Cosmetics Research Division, and the Medical Devices Research Division; the heads of each division shall be appointed as Health Research Officers or Industrial Research Officers. <Amended Jan. 9, 2015; Aug. 31, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ③ 의약품연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2015. 1. 9.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Pharmaceutical Research Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jan. 9, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. 의약품의 시험 방법 개발
rows.text_en: 1. Development of testing methods for pharmaceuticals

rows.source_ko: 2. 의약품의 제제학적 평가기법 개발
rows.text_en: 2. Development of Pharmaceutical Evaluation Techniques for Pharmaceuticals

rows.source_ko: 3. 대한민국약전 등 의약품 규격 고시를 위한 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 3. Technical support for the notification of pharmaceutical standards, such as the Korean Pharmacopoeia

rows.source_ko: 4. 의약품의 제조 및 품질관리기준에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on Manufacturing and Quality Control Standards for Pharmaceuticals

rows.source_ko: 5. 의약품 표준품 관리 및 분양
rows.text_en: 5. Management and Distribution of Pharmaceutical Standards

rows.source_ko: 6. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 표준품 운영 총괄
rows.text_en: 6. Overall management of standard references for food, pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 의약품 시험기관 지정 및 실태조사 지원
rows.text_en: 7. Support for Designation of Pharmaceutical Testing Institutions and On-site Inspections

rows.source_ko: 8. 의약품 시험 검정
rows.text_en: 8. Pharmaceutical Testing and Verification

rows.source_ko: 9. 의약품의 신약허가제도 등에 관련한 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 9. Technical support related to the new drug approval system, etc.

rows.source_ko: 10. 의약품 허가 등 지침서 개발을 위한 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 10. Technical support for the development of guidelines for drug approval, etc.

rows.source_ko: 11. 의약품의 신약 및 개량신약의 안전성ㆍ유효성 심사에 관련한 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 11. Technical support related to the safety and efficacy review of new drugs and improved drugs

rows.source_ko: 12. 의약품의 신약 및 개량신약의 품질심사 및 실태조사에 관련한 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 12. Technical support related to quality review and on-site inspection of new and improved drugs.

rows.source_ko: 13. 의약품 허가 등 관련 정보 데이터베이스 구축
rows.text_en: 13. Establishment of a database for information related to drug approvals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 14. 제1호부터 제13호까지의 사항과 관련된 조사ㆍ연구 및 국제기술협력
rows.text_en: 14. Investigation, research, and international technical cooperation related to the matters under Items 1 through 13

rows.source_ko: 15. 그 밖에 부내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 15. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other divisions within the department

rows.source_ko: ④ 바이오의약품연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2015. 1. 9., 2020. 8. 31.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Biopharmaceutical Research Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jan. 9, 2015; Aug. 31, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 생물학적제제, 유전자재조합의약품 및 사람 태반에서 유래한 의약품의 허가 및 심사에 관련한 조사 및 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Investigations and research related to the approval and review of biological products, recombinant drugs, and drugs derived from the human placenta

rows.source_ko: 2. 생물학적제제, 유전자재조합의약품 및 사람 태반에서 유래한 의약품의 제조 및 품질관리기준에 관한 조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 2. Investigation and research on manufacturing and quality control standards for biological products, genetically modified drugs, and drugs derived from human placenta

rows.source_ko: 3. 생물학적제제, 유전자재조합의약품 및 사람 태반에서 유래한 의약품의 평가기법 개발
rows.text_en: 3. Development of Evaluation Techniques for Biological Products, Recombinant Gene Drugs, and Drugs Derived from Human Placenta

rows.source_ko: 4. 생물학적제제 및 유전자재조합의약품의 지침서 개발
rows.text_en: 4. Development of Guidelines for Biological Products and Recombinant Gene Products

rows.source_ko: 5. 생물학적제제, 유전자재조합의약품 및 사람 태반에서 유래한 의약품의 시험법 검토 및 개발
rows.text_en: 5. Review and development of test methods for biological products, recombinant drugs, and drugs derived from human placenta

rows.source_ko: 6. 생물학적제제 기준 및 시험방법 등의 규격 고시를 위한 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 6. Technical support for the promulgation of standards, test methods, etc. for biological products

rows.source_ko: 7. 생물학적제제, 유전자재조합의약품 및 사람태반에서 유래한 의약품의 시험기관 지정 및 실태조사 지원
rows.text_en: 7. Support for the designation of testing institutions and on-site inspections of biological products, recombinant genetic medicines, and medicines derived from human placenta

rows.source_ko: 8. 생물의약품의 표준품 및 백신 세포주 관리 및 분양
rows.text_en: 8. Management and Distribution of Biological Product Standards and Vaccine Cell Lines

rows.source_ko: 9. 생물학적제제 등의 품질보증제도 운영
rows.text_en: 9. Operation of Quality Assurance System for Biological Products, etc.

rows.source_ko: 10. 생물학적제제 등의 세계보건기구(WHO) 협력센터 운영 등 국제기술협력
rows.text_en: 10. International technical cooperation, including the operation of a World Health Organization (WHO) collaborating center for biological products, etc.

rows.source_ko: 11. 생물학적제제, 유전자재조합의약품 및 사람 태반에서 유래한 의약품의 시험 검정
rows.text_en: 11. Testing and Evaluation of Biological Products, Recombinant Genetic Materials, and Medicines Derived from Human Placenta

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 첨단바이오융복합연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2015. 1. 9., 2020. 8. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Advanced Bio-Convergence Research Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jan. 9, 2015; Aug. 31, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 첨단바이오의약품 및 관련 융복합 의료제품의 허가 및 심사에 관련한 조사 및 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Investigation and research related to the approval and review of advanced biopharmaceuticals and related convergence medical products

rows.source_ko: 2. 첨단바이오의약품 및 관련 융복합 의료제품의 제조 및 품질관리기준에 관한 조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research and Study on Manufacturing and Quality Control Standards for Advanced Biopharmaceuticals and Related Convergence Medical Products

rows.source_ko: 3. 첨단바이오의약품 및 관련 융복합 의료제품의 평가기법 개발
rows.text_en: 3. Development of Evaluation Techniques for Advanced Biopharmaceuticals and Related Convergence Medical Products

rows.source_ko: 4. 첨단바이오의약품 및 관련 융복합 의료제품의 지침서 개발
rows.text_en: 4. Development of Guidelines for Advanced Biopharmaceuticals and Related Convergence Medical Products

rows.source_ko: 5. 첨단바이오의약품 및 관련 융복합 의료제품의 시험법 검토 및 개발
rows.text_en: 5. Review and Development of Test Methods for Advanced Biopharmaceuticals and Related Convergence Medical Products

rows.source_ko: 6. 첨단바이오의약품 및 관련 융복합 의료제품의 표준품 관리 및 확립
rows.text_en: 6. Management and Establishment of Standard Reference Materials for Advanced Biopharmaceuticals and Related Convergence Medical Products

rows.source_ko: 7. 첨단바이오의약품 및 관련 융복합 의료제품의 시험 검정
rows.text_en: 7. Testing and Verification of Advanced Biopharmaceuticals and Related Convergence Medical Products

rows.source_ko: 8. 인체조직 관련 조사ㆍ연구ㆍ지침서 개발
rows.text_en: 8. Development of surveys, research, and guidelines related to human tissues

rows.source_ko: 9. 유전자변형생물체 실험 관련 생물안전관리 기술지원
rows.text_en: 9. Technical support for biosafety management related to genetically modified organism experiments

rows.source_ko: 10. 첨단바이오의약품 및 관련 융복합 의료제품의 시험기관 지정 및 실태조사 지원
rows.text_en: 10. Support for Designation of Testing Institutions and On-site Inspections of Advanced Biopharmaceuticals and Related Convergence Medical Products

rows.source_ko: 11. 인체세포등 관리업 관리 관련 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 11. Technical support related to the management of human cell and tissue management businesses

rows.source_ko: 12. 인체세포등 원료 안전관리 기술 지원 및 연구
rows.text_en: 12. Technical support and research on safety management of raw materials such as human cells

rows.source_ko: 13. 첨단바이오의약품 및 관련 융복합 의료제품 장기추적조사 기술 지원 및 연구
rows.text_en: 13. Technical support and research for long-term follow-up studies of advanced biopharmaceuticals and related convergence medical products

rows.source_ko: 14. 첨단바이오의약품 및 관련 융복합 의료제품의 연구개발 촉진 지원
rows.text_en: 14. Support for the Promotion of Research and Development of Advanced Biopharmaceuticals and Related Convergence Medical Products

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 생약연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2014. 8. 20.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Herbal Medicine Research Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Aug. 20, 2014>

rows.source_ko: 1. 한약등의 품질기준 및 의약품 등 시험ㆍ검사기관(시험ㆍ검사 분야에 한약이 포함된 기관만 해당한다) 지정 및 실태조사 지원
rows.text_en: 1. Support for quality standards for herbal medicines, etc., designation of testing and inspection institutions for pharmaceuticals, etc. (only applicable to institutions whose testing and inspection fields include herbal medicines), and status surveys

rows.source_ko: 2. 한약등의 위해관리 및 유해물질의 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 2. Risk Management of Herbal Medicines, etc. and Technical Support for Hazardous Substances

rows.source_ko: 3. 한약등의 안전성ㆍ유효성 심사에 관한 조사ㆍ연구 등 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 3. Technical support, such as investigations and research regarding the safety and efficacy review of herbal medicines, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 한약등의 시험 검정(관능검사를 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 4. Testing and verification of herbal medicines, etc. (including sensory evaluation)

rows.source_ko: 5. 생약종합정보시스템의 운영
rows.text_en: 5. Operation of the Comprehensive Herbal Medicine Information System

rows.source_ko: 6. 「멸종위기에 처한 야생동식물종의 국제거래에 관한 협약」의 과학적 검토 업무 및 생약 관련 국제협력의 기술 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning scientific review work under the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora and technical support for international cooperation related to medicinal plants

rows.source_ko: 7. 생약의 표준품 및 대조(對照)생약 제조ㆍ분양ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 7. Preparation, Distribution, and Management of Standard Samples and Reference Herbal Medicines

rows.source_ko: 8. 생약자원센터의 관리 및 운영
rows.text_en: 8. Management and Operation of the Medicinal Plant Resource Center

rows.source_ko: 9. 생약의 표본관리, 생약자원의 수집, 개발 및 보존에 관한 조사 및 연구
rows.text_en: 9. Survey and research on specimen management of crude drugs, collection, development, and preservation of crude drug resources

rows.source_ko: 10. 한약등의 허가 및 심사에 관련한 조사 및 연구
rows.text_en: 10. Investigation and research related to the approval and review of herbal medicines, etc.

rows.source_ko: 11. 한약등의 제조 및 품질관리기준에 관한 조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 11. Research and investigation on manufacturing and quality control standards for herbal medicines, etc.

rows.source_ko: 12. 생약자원의 데이터베이스 구축 및 운영
rows.text_en: 12. Establishment and Operation of a Database of Medicinal Plant Resources

rows.source_ko: 13. 한약재 자원관의 운영
rows.text_en: 13. Operation of the Herbal Medicine Resource Center

rows.source_ko: 14. 한약등의 시험법 개발
rows.text_en: 14. Development of Test Methods for Herbal Medicines, etc.
⑦ The Head of the Cosmetics Research Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Feb. 27, 2020; Aug. 31, 2020; Jul. 31, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 화장품ㆍ의약외품 및 위생용품(구강관리용품 및 식품안전과 관련된 위생용품은 제외한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다)의 기준ㆍ규격 및 평가에 관한 조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research and investigation regarding standards, specifications, and evaluation of cosmetics, quasi-drugs, and sanitary products (excluding oral care products and sanitary products related to food safety; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph).

rows.source_ko: 2. 화장품 및 의약외품의 제조 및 품질관리기준에 관한 조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research and investigation on manufacturing and quality control standards for cosmetics and quasi-drugs

rows.source_ko: 3. 화장품 및 위생용품의 위해관리 및 유해물질 기준에 관한 조사 및 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Investigation and Research on Risk Management and Hazardous Substance Standards for Cosmetics and Sanitary Products

rows.source_ko: 4. 화장품ㆍ의약외품 및 위생용품의 안전성 심사에 관한 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 4. Technical support for safety assessment of cosmetics, quasi-drugs, and hygiene products

rows.source_ko: 5. 화장품ㆍ의약외품 및 위생용품 시험ㆍ검사기관 지정 및 실태조사 지원
rows.text_en: 5. Support for Designation of Testing and Inspection Agencies for Cosmetics, Quasi-Drugs, and Sanitary Products, and On-site Inspections

rows.source_ko: 6. 화장품ㆍ의약외품 표준품 관리 및 분양
rows.text_en: 6. Management and Distribution of Standard Reference Materials for Cosmetics and Quasi-Drugs

rows.source_ko: 7. 제1호부터 제6호까지의 사항과 관련된 시험 검정
rows.text_en: 7. Tests and certifications related to the matters in Items 1 through 6
⑧ The Head of the Medical Device Research Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Aug. 20, 2014; Jan. 9, 2015; Aug. 31, 2020; Feb. 26, 2021; Jul. 31, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 의료기기의 시험 방법, 평가기술 개발 및 시험ㆍ검사
rows.text_en: 1. Development of test methods and evaluation technologies for medical devices, and testing and inspection

rows.source_ko: 2. 의료기기 시험ㆍ검사기관 및 품질관리 심사기관의 지도ㆍ감독에 관한 기술지원
rows.text_en: 2. Technical support regarding the guidance and supervision of medical device testing and inspection institutions and quality control review institutions

rows.source_ko: 3. 의료기기에 관한 검정 및 시험분석 업무의 지원
rows.text_en: 3. Support for certification and test analysis services regarding medical devices

rows.source_ko: 4. 의료기기 관련 기준규격 고시 등을 위한 기술지원
rows.text_en: 4. Technical support for the notification of standards and specifications related to medical devices

rows.source_ko: 5. 의료기기 허가 및 기술문서 심사, 임상시험계획 승인 등에 관한 지침서 개발
rows.text_en: 5. Development of guidelines regarding medical device approval, technical documentation review, and clinical trial plan approval, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. 의료기기의 허가 및 심사에 관련한 조사 및 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Investigations and research related to the approval and review of medical devices

rows.source_ko: 7. 의료기기의 제조 및 품질관리기준 관련 조사ㆍ연구 및 국제의료기기 규제조화 기구(IMDRF) 등 국제기구 협력업무 지원
rows.text_en: 7. Support for research and studies related to manufacturing and quality management standards for medical devices, and cooperation with international organizations such as the International Medical Device Regulatory Harmonisation (IMDRF).

rows.source_ko: 8. 의료기기의 안전관리를 위한 위해평가에 관한 기술지원 및 부작용 관련 연구기획
rows.text_en: 8. Technical support for risk assessment for the safety management of medical devices and research planning regarding adverse effects

rows.source_ko: 9. 첨단 융합기술의료기기 등의 평가기술 개발 및 시험ㆍ검사
rows.text_en: 9. Development of evaluation technologies and testing/inspection of advanced convergence technology medical devices, etc.

rows.source_ko: 10. 체외진단의료기기의 표준품 제조ㆍ확립ㆍ관리 및 분양
rows.text_en: 10. Manufacture, establishment, management, and distribution of standard samples for in vitro diagnostic medical devices

rows.source_ko: 11. 처내 방사선 관련 설비ㆍ장비 및 방사성 동위원소의 안전관리
rows.text_en: 11. Safety management of radiation-related facilities, equipment, and radioactive isotopes within the Department

rows.source_ko: 12. 위생용품 중 구강관리용품의 시험ㆍ검사, 기준ㆍ규격, 안전성에 관한 연구 및 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 12. Research and technical support regarding testing, inspection, standards, specifications, and safety of oral care products among hygiene products

rows.source_ko: 13. 위생용품 중 구강관리용품의 시험ㆍ검사기관 지정 및 실태조사 지원
rows.text_en: 13. Support for Designation of Testing and Inspection Institutions and Status Surveys for Oral Care Products Among Hygiene Products
⑨ Deleted <Jan. 9, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 제24조(독성평가연구부) ① 독성평가연구부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 24 (Department of Toxicology Evaluation Research) ① The head of the Department of Toxicology Evaluation Research shall be appointed from among general civil servants, health research officers, or industrial research officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 독성평가연구부에 독성연구과ㆍ약리마약연구과ㆍ임상연구과ㆍ비임상자원연구과 및 첨단분석과를 두되, 각 과장은 보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2020. 8. 31., 2024. 3. 7.>
rows.text_en: ② The Toxicology Evaluation Research Department shall have the Toxicology Research Division, the Pharmacology and Narcotics Research Division, the Clinical Research Division, the Non-Clinical Resources Research Division, and the Advanced Analysis Division; the heads of each division shall be appointed as Health Research Officers or Industrial Research Officers. <Amended Aug. 31, 2020; Mar. 7, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ③ 독성연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2020. 12. 31., 2024. 3. 7.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Toxicology Research Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 31, 2020; Mar. 7, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 독성물질의 국가관리 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on the National Management of Toxic Substances in Food, Pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 독성정보 수집 및 데이터베이스 구축ㆍ활용
rows.text_en: 2. Collection of Toxicology Information and Establishment and Utilization of Databases

rows.source_ko: 3. 독성시험기준의 운영 및 국제조화에 관한 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 3. Technical support regarding the operation and international harmonization of toxicity testing standards

rows.source_ko: 4. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 위해평가를 위한 독성학적 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 4. Toxicological technical support for risk assessment of food, pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 5. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 독성평가 심사기법 개발 및 교육
rows.text_en: 5. Development and training of toxicity assessment review techniques for food, pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 일반독성, 흡입독성 및 발암성 시험ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 6. Testing and Research on General Toxicity, Inhalation Toxicity, and Carcinogenicity of Foods, Pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 조직병리 및 임상병리 연구
rows.text_en: 7. Histopathological and clinical pathology research of food, pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 8. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 현안물질에 대한 독성 시험ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 8. Toxicity testing and research on pending substances in food, pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 9. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 생식ㆍ발생독성 연구 및 후세대 영향 시험ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 9. Research on reproductive and developmental toxicity of food, pharmaceuticals, etc., and testing and research on effects on future generations

rows.source_ko: 10. 식품ㆍ의약품등의 유전독성, 면역독성, 국소독성, 광독성 및 이식독성 시험ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 10. Testing and Research on Genotoxicity, Immunotoxicity, Local Toxicity, Phototoxicity, and Transplant Toxicity of Foods, Pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 11. 비임상시험관리기준(GLP)에 관한 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 11. Technical support regarding Good Laboratory Practice (GLP)

rows.source_ko: 12. 그 밖에 부내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other divisions within the department
④ Deleted <March 7, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 약리마약연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 3. 7.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Pharmacological Narcotics Research Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 7, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 의약품, 건강기능식품, 기능성화장품 등의 비임상 효능에 관한 기술적 지원 및 평가시험법 개발
rows.text_en: 1. Technical support for the non-clinical efficacy of pharmaceuticals, health functional foods, functional cosmetics, etc., and development of evaluation test methods

rows.source_ko: 2. 약물의존성 및 중독성에 관한 시험 및 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Tests and research on drug dependence and addiction

rows.source_ko: 3. 마약류ㆍ오남용 우려 약물의 지정ㆍ관리에 관한 기술 지원 및 시험ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 3. Technical support and testing/research regarding the designation and management of narcotics and drugs at risk of misuse and abuse

rows.source_ko: 4. 의약품의 흡수분포대사배설에 관한 시험 및 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Tests and Research on the Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, and Excretion of Pharmaceuticals

rows.source_ko: 5. 의약품의 안전성약리에 관한 기술적 지원 및 시험ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 5. Technical support and testing/research regarding the safety pharmacology of pharmaceuticals

rows.source_ko: 6. 생리활성물질의 생체내 기능 및 상호작용에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Research on the in vivo functions and interactions of bioactive substances

rows.source_ko: 7. 유전체, 대사체 등을 이용한 의약품의 평가에 관한 기술 지원 및 연구
rows.text_en: 7. Technical support and research on the evaluation of pharmaceuticals using genomics, metabolites, etc.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 임상연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of Clinical Research is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 의약품, 건강기능식품, 기능성화장품의 임상시험 평가기준에 관한 기술 지원 및 시험ㆍ조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 1. Technical support and testing, investigation, and research regarding clinical trial evaluation standards for pharmaceuticals, health functional foods, and functional cosmetics

rows.source_ko: 2. 약물유전정보를 이용한 맞춤약물 평가기술에 관한 조사 및 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Investigation and Research on Personalized Drug Evaluation Technology Using Pharmacogenetic Information

rows.source_ko: 3. 약물유전정보 자원관리 및 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the management and operation of pharmacogenetic information resources

rows.source_ko: 4. 의약품의 민족적 감수성 평가에 관한 기술 지원 및 시험ㆍ조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 4. Technical support and testing, surveys, and research regarding the assessment of ethnic sensitivities of pharmaceuticals

rows.source_ko: 5. 임상시험관리기준(GCP)에 관한 기술 지원 및 조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 5. Technical support and research on Good Clinical Practice (GCP)

rows.source_ko: 6. 비임상시험자료의 임상 적용에 필요한 중개기술에 관한 기술 지원 및 조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 6. Technical support and investigation/research regarding translational technologies necessary for the clinical application of non-clinical trial data

rows.source_ko: 7. 임상시험 등록에 관한 기술 지원 및 조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 7. Technical support and investigation/research regarding clinical trial registration

rows.source_ko: 8. 임상시험 윤리위원회에 관한 기술 지원 및 조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 8. Technical support and investigation/research regarding Clinical Trial Ethics Committees

rows.source_ko: 9. 의약품 안전관리를 위한 위해평가에 관한 기술 지원 및 부작용 관련 연구 기획
rows.text_en: 9. Technical support for risk assessment for drug safety management and planning of adverse effect-related research

rows.source_ko: 10. 의약품 적정사용기준 개발에 관한 조사ㆍ연구 및 기술 검토
rows.text_en: 10. Investigation, Research, and Technical Review Regarding the Development of Standards for the Appropriate Use of Pharmaceuticals

rows.source_ko: 11. 약물감시 및 약물이상반응에 관한 조사ㆍ연구 및 기술 지원
rows.text_en: 11. Investigation, research, and technical support regarding pharmacovigilance and adverse drug reactions

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 비임상자원연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2018. 12. 11., 2024. 3. 7.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Non-Clinical Resources Research Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 11, 2018; Mar. 7, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 동물대체시험법의 연구ㆍ개발 및 검증
rows.text_en: 1. Research, development, and validation of alternative animal testing methods

rows.source_ko: 2. 실험동물관리에 대한 국제수준의 인증관리
rows.text_en: 2. International-level certification management for laboratory animal care

rows.source_ko: 3. 실험동물 공급 및 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Supply and Management of Laboratory Animals

rows.source_ko: 4. 유용실험동물자원의 개발연구 및 종(種) 보존에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on the development of useful experimental animal resources and species conservation

rows.source_ko: 5. 실험동물 품질관리 등에 관한 시험 및 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Tests and research regarding quality control of laboratory animals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. 실험동물시설의 청정도 유지를 위한 환경관리
rows.text_en: 6. Environmental management for maintaining the cleanliness of laboratory animal facilities

rows.source_ko: 제4장 지방식품의약품안전청

rows.source_ko: 제25조(지방식품의약품안전청) ① 지방식품의약품안전청장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 25 (Regional Food and Drug Safety Administration) ① The head of a regional food and drug safety administration shall be appointed from among general civil servants, health research officers, or industrial research officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

② The auxiliary agencies established within the Regional Food and Drug Administrations are as follows: <Amended May 29, 2015; December 4, 2015; Jan. 9, 2020; Aug. 31, 2020; Feb. 26, 2021; Aug. 30, 2023; Sep. 23, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 서울지방식품의약품안전청: 운영지원과ㆍ식품안전관리과ㆍ농축수산물안전과ㆍ의약품안전관리과ㆍ의료기기안전관리과ㆍ수입관리과ㆍ유해물질분석과 및 식품기준분석과를 두되, 운영지원과장 및 의약품안전관리과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ식품위생사무관ㆍ약무사무관ㆍ의료기술사무관 또는 행정사무관으로, 식품안전관리과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 수석전문관으로, 농축수산물안전과장은 식품위생사무관ㆍ수의사무관 또는 행정사무관으로, 의료기기안전관리과장은 약무사무관ㆍ의료기술사무관ㆍ행정사무관ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로, 수입관리과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 수석전문관으로, 유해물질분석과장은 보건연구관으로, 식품기준분석과장은 식품위생사무관ㆍ약무사무관 또는 보건연구관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: 1. Seoul Regional Food and Drug Administration: It shall have the Operations Support Division, Food Safety Management Division, Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries Products Safety Division, Drug Safety Management Division, Medical Device Safety Management Division, Import Management Division, Hazardous Substance Analysis Division, and Food Standards Analysis Division. The heads of the Operations Support Division and the Drug Safety Management Division shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Food Hygiene Officer, Pharmaceutical Officer, Medical Technology Officer, or Administrative Officer; the head of the Food Safety Management Division shall be appointed as Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, or Senior Specialist; the head of the Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries Products Safety Division shall be appointed as Food Hygiene Officer, Veterinary Officer, or Administrative Officer; the head of the Medical Device Safety Management Division shall be appointed as Pharmaceutical Officer, Medical Technology Officer, Administrative Officer, Health Research Officer, or Industrial Research Officer; the head of the Import Management Division shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, or Senior Specialist; the head of the Hazardous Substance Analysis Division shall be appointed as Health Research Officer; and the head of the Food Standards Analysis Division shall be appointed as Food Hygiene Officer, Pharmaceutical Officer, or Health Research Officer.

rows.source_ko: 2. 부산지방식품의약품안전청: 운영지원과ㆍ식품안전관리과ㆍ농축수산물안전과ㆍ의료제품안전과 및 수입관리과를 두되, 운영지원과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 식품안전관리과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 수석전문관으로, 농축수산물안전과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ보건연구관 또는 수석전문관으로, 의료제품안전과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ약무사무관ㆍ의료기술사무관 또는 행정사무관으로, 수입관리과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 수석전문관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: 2. Busan Regional Food and Drug Administration: It shall have the Operations Support Division, Food Safety Management Division, Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries Products Safety Division, Medical Products Safety Division, and Import Management Division. The head of the Operations Support Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary; the head of the Food Safety Management Division as a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, or Senior Specialist; the head of the Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries Products Safety Division as a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Health Research Officer, or Senior Specialist; the head of the Medical Products Safety Division as a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Pharmaceutical Affairs Officer, Medical Technology Officer, or Administrative Officer; and the head of the Import Management Division as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, or Senior Specialist.

rows.source_ko: 3. 경인지방식품의약품안전청: 운영지원과ㆍ식품안전관리과ㆍ농축수산물안전과ㆍ의료제품안전과ㆍ의료제품실사과 및 수입관리과를 두되, 운영지원과장ㆍ의료제품안전과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ식품위생사무관ㆍ약무사무관ㆍ의료기술사무관 또는 행정사무관으로, 식품안전관리과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 수석전문관으로, 농축수산물안전과장은 식품위생사무관ㆍ수의사무관 또는 행정사무관으로, 의료제품실사과장은 약무사무관ㆍ의료기술사무관ㆍ행정사무관ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로, 수입관리과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 수석전문관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: 3. Gyeongin Regional Food and Drug Administration: It shall have the Operations Support Division, Food Safety Management Division, Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries Products Safety Division, Medical Products Safety Division, Medical Products Inspection Division, and Import Management Division. The heads of the Operations Support Division and the Medical Products Safety Division shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Food Hygiene Officer, Pharmaceutical Officer, Medical Technology Officer, or Administrative Officer; the head of the Food Safety Management Division shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, or Senior Specialist; the head of the Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries Products Safety Division shall be appointed as Food Hygiene Officer, Veterinary Officer, or Administrative Officer; the head of the Medical Products Inspection Division shall be appointed as Pharmaceutical Officer, Medical Technology Officer, Administrative Officer, Health Research Officer, or Industrial Research Officer; and the head of the Import Management Division shall be appointed as Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, or Senior Specialist.

rows.source_ko: 4. 대구지방식품의약품안전청: 운영지원과ㆍ식품안전관리과ㆍ의료제품안전과 및 유해물질분석과를 두되, 운영지원과장ㆍ식품안전관리과장 및 의료제품안전과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ식품위생사무관ㆍ약무사무관ㆍ의료기술사무관 또는 행정사무관으로, 유해물질분석과장은 식품위생사무관ㆍ약무사무관 또는 보건연구관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: 4. Daegu Regional Food and Drug Administration: It shall have the Operations Support Division, Food Safety Management Division, Medical Product Safety Division, and Hazardous Substance Analysis Division. The heads of the Operations Support Division, Food Safety Management Division, and Medical Product Safety Division shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Food Hygiene Officer, Pharmaceutical Officer, Medical Technology Officer, or Administrative Officer, and the head of the Hazardous Substance Analysis Division shall be appointed as Food Hygiene Officer, Pharmaceutical Officer, or Health Research Officer.

rows.source_ko: 5. 광주지방식품의약품안전청: 운영지원과ㆍ식품안전관리과ㆍ농축수산물안전과ㆍ의료제품안전과 및 유해물질분석과를 두되, 운영지원과장ㆍ식품안전관리과장 및 의료제품안전과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ식품위생사무관ㆍ약무사무관ㆍ의료기술사무관 또는 행정사무관으로, 농축수산물안전과장은 식품위생사무관ㆍ수의사무관 또는 행정사무관으로, 유해물질분석과장은 식품위생사무관ㆍ약무사무관 또는 보건연구관으로 보한다.

The heads of the Operations Support Division, Food Safety Management Division, and Medical Products Safety Division shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Food Hygiene Officer, Pharmaceutical Officer, Medical Technology Officer, or Administrative Officer; the head of the Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries Products Safety Division shall be appointed as Food Hygiene Officer, Veterinary Officer, or Administrative Officer; and the head of the Hazardous Substances Analysis Division shall be appointed as Food Hygiene Officer, Pharmaceutical Officer, or Health Research Officer.

rows.source_ko: 6. 대전지방식품의약품안전청: 운영지원과ㆍ식품안전관리과ㆍ의료제품안전과ㆍ의료제품실사과 및 유해물질분석과를 두되, 운영지원과장ㆍ식품안전관리과장 및 의료제품안전과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ식품위생사무관ㆍ약무사무관ㆍ의료기술사무관 또는 행정사무관으로, 의료제품실사과장은 약무사무관ㆍ의료기술사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 보건연구관으로, 유해물질분석과장은 식품위생사무관ㆍ약무사무관 또는 보건연구관으로 보한다.

③ The Head of the Operations Support Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jan. 9, 2015; May 19, 2016; Sep. 28, 2017; Dec. 11, 2018; Feb. 27, 2020; Dec. 31, 2020; Feb. 26, 2021; Sep. 15, 2022>
