rows.source_ko: ⑧ 의료제품안전과장은 제6항 각 호(같은 항 제9호부터 제12호까지를 제외한다)의 사항 및 제7항 각 호(같은 항 제7호를 제외한다)의 사항을 함께 분장한다. 다만, 의료제품실사과가 없는 지방식품의약품안전청의 의료제품안전과장은 제9항 각 호의 사항도 함께 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Head of the Medical Products Safety Division shall be responsible for the matters in each subparagraph of Paragraph 6 (excluding subparagraphs 9 through 12 of the same paragraph) and the matters in each subparagraph of Paragraph 7 (excluding subparagraph 7 of the same paragraph). However, the Head of the Medical Products Safety Division of a regional Food and Drug Administration that does not have a Medical Products Inspection Division shall also be responsible for the matters in each subparagraph of Paragraph 9.

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 의료제품실사과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2015. 5. 29., 2021. 2. 26.>
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Head of the Medical Product Inspection Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended May 29, 2015; Feb. 26, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 의약품등의 제조업소 및 제조품목, 제조판매품목, 화장품의 제조 및 품질관리기준 평가 및 지도
rows.text_en: 1. Evaluation and guidance on manufacturing and quality control standards for pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities, manufactured products, manufactured and sold products, and cosmetics.

rows.source_ko: 2. 원료의약품 제조업소의 제조 및 품질관리기준 평가 및 지도
rows.text_en: 2. Evaluation and guidance on manufacturing and quality control standards of active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) manufacturers

rows.source_ko: 3. 등록 대상 원료의약품(사람 태반에서 유래한 의약품을 포함한다) 국내 실태조사
rows.text_en: 3. Domestic Status Survey of Registered Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (including pharmaceuticals derived from human placenta)

rows.source_ko: 4. 의약품동등성 시험 신뢰성 조사
rows.text_en: 4. Investigation into the Reliability of Pharmaceutical Equivalence Testing

rows.source_ko: 5. 의료기기 제조ㆍ수입업자에 대한 제조 및 품질관리기준 심사
rows.text_en: 5. Review of manufacturing and quality control standards for medical device manufacturers and importers

rows.source_ko: 6. 첨단바이오의약품 제조업자의 제조 및 품질관리 기준 평가ㆍ지도
rows.text_en: 6. Evaluation and Guidance on Manufacturing and Quality Control Standards of Advanced Biopharmaceutical Manufacturers

rows.source_ko: 7. 세포처리시설 및 인체세포 등 관리업의 허가ㆍ변경허가ㆍ허가증 갱신에 대한 시설ㆍ장비ㆍ인력 등의 평가 및 실태조사
rows.text_en: 7. Evaluation of facilities, equipment, personnel, etc., and on-site inspection regarding the permit, amendment of permit, and renewal of permit for cell processing facilities and human cell, etc. management businesses

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 수입관리과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2016. 5. 19., 2020. 2. 27.>
rows.text_en: 10. The Head of the Import Management Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended May 19, 2016; Feb. 27, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 수입식품등 및 수입 위생용품의 신고수리ㆍ검사 및 관리
rows.text_en: 1. Acceptance of Declarations, Inspection, and Management of Imported Foods, etc. and Imported Sanitary Products

rows.source_ko: 2. 수입식품등 및 수입 위생용품의 검사를 위한 수거
rows.text_en: 2. Collection for inspection of imported food products and imported sanitary products

rows.source_ko: 3. 수입 부적합 식품등과 위생용품의 반송ㆍ폐기처분 등 사후관리
rows.text_en: 3. Post-management, including return and disposal, of unsuitable imported food products and sanitary products

rows.source_ko: 4. 식품등과 위생용품의 수입검사전산망의 운영 및 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Operation and Management of the Computerized Import Inspection Network for Food Products and Sanitary Products

rows.source_ko: 5. 영업자에 대한 식품(축산물은 제외한다)안전 교육명령에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning orders for food safety education (excluding livestock products) for business operators

rows.source_ko: 6. 수입자 등에 대한 교육 및 홍보
rows.text_en: 6. Education and promotion for importers, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 여행객의 휴대품ㆍ특송화물ㆍ우편물품 중 식품등에 대한 검사
rows.text_en: 7. Inspection of food items, etc., among travelers' personal belongings, express cargo, and postal items

rows.source_ko: 8. 수입식품등ㆍ수출 축산물 및 수입 위생용품의 검사 통계
rows.text_en: 8. Inspection Statistics for Imported Foods, Exported Livestock Products, and Imported Sanitary Products

rows.source_ko: 9. 축산물 보관창고 위생관리
rows.text_en: 9. Hygiene Management of Livestock Product Storage Warehouses

rows.source_ko: 10. 축산물 보관장소에 입고된 축산물의 검사
rows.text_en: 10. Inspection of livestock products received at the storage facility

rows.source_ko: 11. 수입식품영업의 등록
rows.text_en: 11. Registration of Imported Food Business

rows.source_ko: 12. 위생용품수입업의 신고의 수리
rows.text_en: 12. Acceptance of notification for sanitary product import business

rows.source_ko: ⑪ 유해물질분석과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. 다만, 대구지방식품의약품안전청, 광주지방식품의약품안전청 및 대전지방식품의약품안전청의 유해물질분석과장은 제12항의 사항도 함께 분장한다. <개정 2021. 2. 26.>
rows.text_en: 11. The Head of the Hazardous Substances Analysis Division shall be responsible for the following matters. However, the Heads of the Hazardous Substances Analysis Divisions of the Daegu Regional Food and Drug Administration, the Gwangju Regional Food and Drug Administration, and the Daejeon Regional Food and Drug Administration shall also be responsible for the matters under Paragraph 12. <Amended Feb. 26, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 식품등의 유해물질에 대한 검사(중금속 항목은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Inspection for harmful substances in food, etc. (excluding heavy metals)

rows.source_ko: 2. 식품등의 잔류농약 등에 대한 검사
rows.text_en: 2. Inspection of pesticide residues, etc. in food

rows.source_ko: 3. 식품등의 미생물 등에 대한 검사
rows.text_en: 3. Inspection of microorganisms, etc. in food

rows.source_ko: 4. 유전자변형식품에 대한 검사
rows.text_en: 4. Inspection of genetically modified foods

rows.source_ko: 5. 의약품, 마약류, 화장품 및 의약외품 등의 검사
rows.text_en: 5. Inspection of pharmaceuticals, narcotics, cosmetics, and quasi-pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. 의약품 등의 품질검사
rows.text_en: 6. Quality inspection of pharmaceuticals, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 제1호부터 제6호와 관련된 검사능력관리, 모니터링 조사ㆍ연구, 시험검사기관의 지정 및 지도ㆍ감독 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning inspection capability management, monitoring investigations and research, and support for the designation, guidance, and supervision of testing and inspection institutions related to Subparagraphs 1 through 6

rows.source_ko: ⑫ 식품기준분석과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 2. 26.>
rows.text_en: ⑫ The Head of the Food Standards Analysis Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Feb. 26, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 식품등의 일반성분 및 영양성분에 대한 검사
rows.text_en: 1. Inspection of general and nutritional components of food, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 식품등의 중금속 등에 대한 검사
rows.text_en: 2. Inspection of heavy metals, etc. in food

rows.source_ko: 3. 식품첨가물, 기구 및 용기ㆍ포장에 대한 검사
rows.text_en: 3. Inspection of food additives, equipment, and containers and packaging

rows.source_ko: 4. 위생용품에 대한 검사
rows.text_en: 4. Inspection of sanitary products

rows.source_ko: 5. 제1호부터 제4호와 관련된 검사능력관리, 모니터링 조사ㆍ연구, 시험검사기관의 지정 및 지도ㆍ감독 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning inspection capability management, monitoring investigations and research, and support for the designation, guidance, and supervision of testing and inspection institutions related to Subparagraphs 1 through 4
13 Deleted <May 29, 2015>
14 Deleted <May 29, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 제26조(지방식품의약품안전청의 명칭 등) 지방식품의약품안전청의 명칭ㆍ위치 및 관할구역은 별표 1과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 26 (Names, etc. of Regional Food and Drug Safety Agencies) The names, locations, and jurisdictional areas of regional food and drug safety agencies are as set forth in Table 1 .

rows.source_ko: 제27조(지방식품의약품안전청 수입식품검사소의 명칭 등) ① 수입식품검사소의 명칭ㆍ위치 및 관할구역은 별표 2와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 27 (Names, etc. of Import Food Inspection Offices of Regional Food and Drug Administrations) ① The names, locations, and jurisdictional areas of import food inspection offices are as set forth in Table 2 .

rows.source_ko: ② 수입식품검사소에 소장 1명을 두되, 소장은 식품위생사무관ㆍ수의사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2017. 2. 28., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② One Director shall be appointed to the Imported Food Inspection Office, and the Director shall be appointed from among Food Hygiene Officers, Veterinary Officers, or Administrative Officers. <Amended Feb. 28, 2017; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 소장은 소속 지방식품의약품안전청장의 명을 받아 제25조제10항제1호부터 제10호까지의 사항을 통할하고, 소속 공무원을 지휘ㆍ감독한다. <개정 2026. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Director shall, upon the order of the Head of the Regional Food and Drug Administration to which he/she belongs, oversee the matters under Article 25, Paragraph 10, Subparagraphs 1 through 10 , and direct and supervise officials under his/her jurisdiction. <Amended Mar. 24, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제27조의2(지방식품의약품안전청 시험분석센터의 명칭 등) ① 시험분석센터의 명칭ㆍ위치는 별표 2의2와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 27-2 (Name, etc. of Regional Food and Drug Administration Testing and Analysis Centers) ① The names and locations of testing and analysis centersare as set forth in Table 2-2 .

rows.source_ko: ② 시험분석센터에는 센터장 1명을 두되, 센터장은 과학기술서기관 또는 보건연구관으로 보한다. 다만, 센터장은 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제27조제3항에 따라 상호이체하여 배정ㆍ운영하는 3급 또는 4급으로 보할 수 있다. <개정 2017. 2. 28., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Testing and Analysis Center shall have one Director, who shall be appointed as a Senior Secretary for Science and Technology or a Research Officer for Health. However, the Director may be appointed as a Grade 3 or Grade 4 official assigned and operated through mutual transfer in accordance with Article 27, Paragraph 3 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies . <Amended Feb. 28, 2017; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 시험분석센터에 두는 보조기관으로 유해물질분석과 및 식품기준분석과를 두되, 유해물질분석과장 및 식품기준분석과장은 식품위생사무관ㆍ약무사무관 또는 보건연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2021. 2. 26.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Hazardous Substances Analysis Division and the Food Standards Analysis Division shall be established as auxiliary organizations within the Testing and Analysis Center; provided that the heads of the Hazardous Substances Analysis Division and the Food Standards Analysis Division shall be appointed from among Food Hygiene Officers, Pharmaceutical Officers, or Health Research Officers. <Amended Feb. 26, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ④ 시험분석센터장은 소속 지방식품의약품안전청장의 명을 받아 제25조제11항 및 제12항 각 호의 사항을 총괄하고, 소속 공무원을 지휘ㆍ감독한다. <개정 2021. 2. 26.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Testing and Analysis Center shall, upon the order of the Head of the Regional Food and Drug Administration to which he/she belongs, oversee the matters set forth in each subparagraph of Article 25, Paragraphs 11 and 12 , and direct and supervise officials under his/her jurisdiction. <Amended Feb. 26, 2021>
[This Article Newly Inserted May 29, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제5장 공무원의 정원
rows.text_en: Chapter 5. Staffing Levels of Public Officials

rows.source_ko: 제28조(식품의약품안전처에 두는 공무원의 정원) ① 식품의약품안전처에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원(「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제25조제1항에 따른 한시정원은 제외한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다)은 별표 3과 같다. 다만, 「식품의약품안전처와 그 소속기관 직제」 제33조제1항 단서에 따라 별표 3에 따른 총정원의 10퍼센트를 넘지 않는 범위에서 따로 정하는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 3의2와 같으며, 별표 3의2의 정원 중 16명(행정사무관ㆍ식품위생사무관ㆍ약무사무관 또는 의료기술사무관 1명, 행정주사ㆍ식품위생주사ㆍ약무주사ㆍ의료기술주사ㆍ전산주사 또는 수의주사 11명, 행정주사ㆍ식품위생주사ㆍ수의주사 또는 전산주사 2명, 보건주사 1명 및 행정주사보ㆍ약무주사보ㆍ의료기술주사보ㆍ전산주사보 또는 수의주사보 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용한다. <개정 2018. 3. 30., 2020. 8. 31., 2021. 6. 30., 2022. 2. 28., 2022. 9. 15., 2022. 12. 30., 2023. 6. 1., 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 3. 7., 2024. 12. 31., 2026. 3. 24., 2026. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 28 (Personnel Quotas for Public Officials in the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety) ① The personnel quotas for public officials in the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety by rank ( excluding temporary personnel quotas pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies ; hereinafter the same shall apply in this Article) are as set forth in Table 3 . However,pursuant to the proviso of Article 33, Paragraph 1 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety and its affiliated agencies,” the number of public officials by rank determined separately within a range not exceeding 10 percent of the total number of officials in Table 3 is as set forth in Table 3-2 , and among the number of officials in Table 3-2, 16 people (1 administrative officer, food hygiene officer, pharmaceutical officer, or medical technology officer; 11 administrative assistants, food hygiene assistants, pharmaceutical assistants, medical technology assistants, computer assistants, or veterinary assistants; 2 administrative assistants, food hygiene assistants, veterinary assistants, or computer assistants; 1 public health assistant; and 1 assistant administrative assistant, assistant pharmaceutical assistant, assistant medical technology assistant, assistant computer assistant, or veterinary assistant) shall be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Amended Mar. 30, 2018; Aug. 31, 2020; Jun. 30, 2021; Feb. 28, 2022; Sep. 15, 2022; Dec. 30, 2022; Jun. 1, 2023; Aug. 30, 2023; Mar. 7, 2024; Dec. 31, 2024; Mar. 24, 2026; July 1, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 식품의약품안전처에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 홍보 및 대외협력 업무를 담당하는 3명(4급 또는 5급 3명) 및 그 밖의 정원 중 2명(4급 2명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있다. <개정 2013. 12. 18., 2017. 9. 28., 2020. 8. 31., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② Among the authorized number of public officials in the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, three persons responsible for public relations and external cooperation (three persons at Grade 4 or 5) and two persons from the remaining authorized number (two persons at Grade 4) may be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Amended Dec. 18, 2013; Sep. 28, 2017; Aug. 31, 2020; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 식품의약품안전처에 두는 공무원 정원 중 공공데이터 관련 업무를 담당하는 1명(5급 1명) 및 디지털 홍보 관련 업무를 담당하는 2명(5급 1명, 6급 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용한다. <신설 2019. 3. 4., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ Among the authorized number of public officials in the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, one person (Grade 5) responsible for public data-related duties and two people (one Grade 5 and one Grade 6) responsible for digital promotion-related duties shall be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Newly added Mar. 4, 2019; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제29조(소속기관에 두는 공무원의 정원) ① 식품의약품안전평가원에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 4와 같으며, 별표 4의 정원 중 3명(4급 또는 연구관 1명, 연구관 2명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있다. <개정 2013. 10. 4., 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 3. 7., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 29 (Personnel Quotas for Public Officials in Affiliated Agencies) ① The personnel quotas for public officials by rank in the Korea Food and Drug Administration (are as set forth in Attached Table 4 ; among the quotas set forth in Attached Table 4 , three persons (one Grade 4 or Research Officer, and two Research Officers) may be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Amended Oct. 4, 2013; Aug. 30, 2023; Mar. 7, 2024; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 지방식품의약품안전청에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 6과 같으며, 별표 6의 정원 중 1명(4급 또는 연구관 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The authorized number of public officials by rank in regional Food and Drug Administrations is as set forth in Attached Table 6 , and one person (one Grade 4 or Research Officer) among the authorized number set forth in Attached Table 6 may be appointed as a fixed-term public official. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(다른 법령의 폐지) 식품의약품안전청과 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙을 폐지한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Repeal of Other Laws)  The Enforcement Rules for the Organization of the Korea Food and Drug Administration and its Affiliated Agencies are hereby repealed.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(기능이관에 따른 공무원에 대한 경과조치) ① 이 규칙 시행 당시 농림수산식품부 소속 공무원 260명(고위공무원 1명, 4급 6명, 4ㆍ5급 1명, 5급 16명, 6급 87명, 7급 78명, 8급 23명, 9급 1명, 연구관 3명, 연구사 29명, 기능8급 1명, 기능9급 14명)은 식품의약품안전처 소속 공무원으로 보아 농림수산식품부에서 식품의약품안전처로 이체한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures for Public Officials Following Transfer of Functions)  ① At the time of the enforcement of this rule, 260 public officials belonging to the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs (1 senior official, 6 Grade 4 officials, 1 Grade 4/5 official, 16 Grade 5 officials, 87 Grade 6 officials, 78 Grade 7 officials, 23 Grade 8 officials, 1 Grade 9 official, 3 research officers, 29 research assistants, 1 functional Grade 8 official, and 14 functional Grade 9 officials) shall be deemed to be public officials belonging to the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety and shall be transferred from the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs to the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety.

rows.source_ko: ② 이 규칙 시행 당시 보건복지부 소속 공무원 10명(4급 1명, 5급 3명, 6급 3명, 8급 2명, 기능9급 1명)은 식품의약품안전처 소속 공무원으로 보아 보건복지부에서 식품의약품안전처로 이체한다.
rows.text_en: ② At the time of the enforcement of this rule, 10 public officials belonging to the Ministry of Health and Welfare (1 Grade 4, 3 Grade 5, 3 Grade 6, 2 Grade 8, and 1 Grade 9 technical official) shall be deemed to be public officials belonging to the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety and shall be transferred from the Ministry of Health and Welfare to the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(정원에 대한 경과조치) 대통령령 제24458호 식품의약품안전처와 그 소속기관 직제 시행으로 이 규칙에 따른 정원을 초과하는 현원 5명(5급 1명, 6급 1명, 7급 1명, 연구사 1명, 기능9급 1명)은 그 초과된 현원이 이 규칙에 따른 정원과 일치될 때까지 그에 상응하는 정원이 식품의약품안전처와 그 소속기관에 따로 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Transitional Measures Regarding Personnel Quotas)  As a result of the implementation of Presidential Decree No. 24458, the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety and its Affiliated Agencies, the five current personnel exceeding the personnel quota under this Rule (1 person at Grade 5, 1 person at Grade 6, 1 person at Grade 7, 1 Researcher, and 1 person at Grade 9 Technical Level) shall be deemed to have separate personnel quotas corresponding to them within the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety and its affiliated agencies until the excess current personnel matches the personnel quota under this Rule.

rows.source_ko: ① 법 제6조제1항제1호 및 제2호에 따라 마약류수출입업자ㆍ마약류제조업자 또는 마약류원료사용자가 되려는 자는 별지 제5호서식의 허가신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)를 식품의약품안전처장에게 제출하여야 한다. 이 경우 마약류수출입업자가 되려는 자는 법 제6조제3항제2호에 해당되지 아니함을 증명하는 의사의 진단서를 첨부하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ① Pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1, Subparagraphs 1 and 2 of the Act, any person who intends to become a narcotics importer/exporter, narcotics manufacturer, or narcotics raw material user shall submit an application for permission in the form of Annex 5 (including an application in the form of an electronic document) to the Minister of Food and Drug Safety. In this case, a person who intends to become a narcotics importer/exporter shall attach a medical certificate from a physician proving that they do not fall under Article 6, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 2 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: ④ 법 제6조제1항제4호에 따라 마약류취급학술연구자가 되려는 자나 법 제6조의2제1항 전단에 따라 원료물질수출입업자 또는 원료물질제조업자(이하 “원료물질수출입업자등”이라 한다)가 되려는 자는 별지 제5호서식의 허가신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류(전자문서를 포함한다)를 첨부하여 지방식품의약품안전청장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ Any person who intends to become an academic researcher handling narcotics pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 of the Act, or any person who intends to become a raw material import/export business operator or raw material manufacturer (hereinafter referred to as “raw material import/export business operator, etc.”) pursuant to the first part of Article 6-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act, shall submit to the head of the regional Food and Drug Safety Administration an application for permission in the form of Annex 5 (including an application in the form of an electronic document) with the following documents (including electronic documents) attached.

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제6조제3항제2호에 해당되지 아니함을 증명하는 의사의 진단서
rows.text_en: 1. A medical certificate from a physician proving that it does not fall under Article 6, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 2 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 마약류의 사용을 필요로 하는 학술연구계획서(마약류취급학술연구자가 되려는 자만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Academic research plan requiring the use of narcotics (applicable only to those intending to become academic researchers handling narcotics)

rows.source_ko: 3. 학술연구자의 자격에 관한 서류(마약류취급학술연구자가 되려는 자만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Documents regarding the qualifications of an academic researcher (applicable only to those intending to become an academic researcher handling narcotics)

rows.source_ko: 4. 취급하는 원료물질의 종류를 기재한 서류(원료물질수출입업자등이 되려는 자만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 4. Documents specifying the types of raw materials handled (applicable only to those intending to become raw material import/export business operators, etc.)

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 제1항 및 제4항에 따라 신청서를 제출받은 식품의약품안전처장 또는 지방식품의약품안전청장은 다음 각 호의 구분에 따라 해당하는 서류를 확인하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Minister of Food and Drug Safety or the head of a regional Food and Drug Safety Administration who receives an application pursuant to Paragraphs 1 and 4 shall verify the corresponding documents according to the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.text_en: 1. In the case of a corporation: Certificate of corporate registration through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 마약류수출입업자가 되려는 자: 「의약품 등의 안전에 관한 규칙」 제59조에 따른 허가대장 또는 신고수리대장을 통한 수입품목허가(신고)증
rows.text_en: 2. Person intending to become a narcotics importer/exporter: Import item permit (notification) certificate through the permit register or notification acceptance register pursuant to Article 59 of the "Rules on the Safety of Pharmaceuticals, etc."

rows.source_ko: 3. 마약류제조업자 또는 마약류원료사용자가 되려는 자: 「의약품 등의 안전에 관한 규칙」 제13조제1항에 따른 허가대장을 통한 의약품제조업허가증

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날로부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(정원에 관한 경과조치) 대통령령 제24965호 식품의약품안전처와 그 소속기관 직제 일부개정령 시행에 따른 초과현원으로서 이 규칙에 따른 정원을 초과하는 현원 17명(5급 3명, 6급 7명, 7급 3명, 8급 1명, 9급 3명)은 그 초과된 현원이 이 규칙에 따른 정원과 일치될 때까지 그에 상응하는 정원이 식품의약품안전처와 그 소속기관에 따로 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Personnel Quotas)  As for the 17 personnel exceeding the personnel quota under this Rule pursuant to the enforcement of Presidential Decree No. 24965, Partial Amendment to the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety and its Affiliated Agencies, the corresponding personnel quota shall be deemed to exist separately within the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety and its affiliated agencies until the excess personnel matches the personnel quota under this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(기능직 폐지에 따른 정원 조정에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행으로 기능직공무원 정원을 감축하여 증원되는 일반직공무원 정원 중 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제26조제2항 및 제3항에 따라 통합ㆍ운영하던 정원이 있는 경우에, 그 통합ㆍ운영하던 직급에 근속승진 임용된 공무원에 대해서는 해당 직급에 재직하는 동안에는 별표 3, 별표 4 및 별표 6의 개정규정에도 불구하고 그 정원이 식품의약품안전처와 그 소속기관에 따로 있는 것으로 보고, 그에 해당하는 종전 직급의 정원은 감축된 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Adjustment of Quotas Following the Abolition of Functional Positions)  In cases where there are quotas for general civil servants that were integrated and operated pursuant to Article 26, Paragraphs 2 and 3 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Quotas of Administrative Agencies” among the quotas for general civil servants that are increased by reducing the quota for functional civil servants due to the enforcement of this Rule, for civil servants appointed by promotion based on seniority to the integrated and operated ranks, notwithstanding the amended provisions of Annex 3, Annex 4, and Annex 6, such quotas shall be deemed to exist separately within the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety and its affiliated agencies while they are serving in the relevant ranks, and the quota for the corresponding former ranks shall be deemed to have been reduced.

rows.source_ko: 제23조제6항제1호 중 “품질검사기관”을 “의약품 등 시험ㆍ검사기관(시험ㆍ검사 분야에 한약이 포함된 기관만 해당한다)”으로 하고, 같은 조 제8항제1호 중 “시험검사”를 “시험ㆍ검사”로 하며, 같은 항 제2호 중 “의료기기 시험검사기관”을 “의료기기 시험ㆍ검사기관”으로 하고, 같은 항 제9호 중 “시험검사”를 “시험ㆍ검사”로 하며, 같은 조 제9항제6호 중 “의료기기 시험검사기관”을 “의료기기 시험ㆍ검사기관”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 23, Paragraph 6, Subparagraph 1, “quality inspection agency” shall be changed to “testing and inspection agency for pharmaceuticals, etc. (only applicable to agencies that include herbal medicine in the testing and inspection field)”; in Paragraph 8, Subparagraph 1 of the same article, “testing and inspection” shall be changed to “testing and inspection”; in Subparagraph 2 of the same paragraph, “medical device testing and inspection agency” shall be changed to “medical device testing and inspection agency”; in Subparagraph 9 of the same paragraph, “testing and inspection” shall be changed to “testing and inspection”; and in Paragraph 9, Subparagraph 6 of the same article, “medical device testing and inspection agency” shall be changed to “medical device testing and inspection agency”.

rows.source_ko: 제24조제7항제3호 중 “시험검사”를 “시험ㆍ검사”로 하고, 같은 항 제4호 중 “시험검사기관”을 “시험ㆍ검사기관”으로 하며, 같은 항 제5호 중 “시험검사기관 검사능력”을 “시험ㆍ검사기관의 시험ㆍ검사능력”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 24, Paragraph 7, Subparagraph 3, “test inspection” shall be changed to “test and inspection”; in Subparagraph 4 of the same paragraph, “test inspection agency” shall be changed to “test and inspection agency”; and in Subparagraph 5 of the same paragraph, “test inspection agency’s inspection capability” shall be changed to “test and inspection capability of a test and inspection agency”.

rows.source_ko: 제25조제4항제16호 중 “식품위생검사기관 중 자가품질위탁검사기관”을 “식품 등 시험ㆍ검사기관 중 자가품질위탁 시험ㆍ검사기관”으로 하고, 같은 조 제11항제5호 중 “식품ㆍ의약품등 시험검사기관”을 “식품ㆍ의약품분야 시험ㆍ검사기관”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 25, Paragraph 4, Subparagraph 16, “self-quality commissioned inspection agencies among food hygiene inspection agencies” shall be changed to “self-quality commissioned testing and inspection agencies among food, etc. testing and inspection agencies,” and in Article 25, Paragraph 11, Subparagraph 5, “testing and inspection agencies for food, pharmaceuticals, etc.” shall be changed to “testing and inspection agencies in the food and pharmaceutical fields.”

rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the amended provisions of Annex 1 and Annex 2 shall enter into force on June 11, 2023.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 신설한 기구의 존속기한) ① 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조에 따라 이 규칙 시행으로 신설되는 디지털수입안전기획팀 및 마약예방재활팀은 각각 2027년 12월 31일까지 존속한다. <개정 2026. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Organizations Newly Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The Digital Import Safety Planning Team and the Narcotics Prevention and Rehabilitation Team, newly established pursuant to Article 29 of the General Rules on the Organization and Staffing of Administrative Agencies upon the enforcement of this Rule, shall each remain in existence until December 31, 2027. <Amended Mar. 24, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 디지털수입안전기획팀장 및 마약예방재활팀장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 존속기한이 지난 날부터 디지털수입안전기획팀장이 분장하는 사항은 수입검사관리과장이, 마약예방재활팀장이 분장하는 사항은 마약정책과장이 각각 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② If no special provisions are made regarding the matters assigned to the Head of the Digital Import Safety Planning Team and the Head of the Narcotics Prevention and Rehabilitation Team until the expiration date under Paragraph 1, then from the day the expiration date under Paragraph 1 has passed, the matters assigned to the Head of the Import Inspection Management Division and the matters assigned to the Head of the Narcotics Prevention and Rehabilitation Team shall be assigned to the Head of the Narcotics Policy Division, respectively.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(총액인건비제로 증원한 정원의 존속기한) ① 이 규칙 시행으로 증원되는 별표 3의2의 정원 2명(행정주사ㆍ식품위생주사ㆍ약무주사ㆍ의료기술주사ㆍ전산주사 또는 수의주사 1명, 행정주사보ㆍ약무주사보ㆍ의료기술주사보ㆍ전산주사보 또는 수의주사보 1명)은 2027년 12월 31일까지 존속한다. <개정 2026. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Duration of Personnel Quotas Increased Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The two personnel quotas specified in Annex 3-2 that are increased by the enforcement of this Rule (one Administrative Assistant, Food Hygiene Assistant, Pharmacy Assistant, Medical Technology Assistant, Computer Assistant, or Veterinary Assistant; and one Assistant Administrative Assistant, Pharmacy Assistant, Medical Technology Assistant, Computer Assistant, or Veterinary Assistant) shall remain in effect until December 31, 2027. <Amended Mar. 24, 2026>

rows.text_en: Article 4 (Duration of Positions Upgraded Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  The authorized quota of 3 positions specified in Annex 3-2 (3 Administrative Officers, Food Hygiene Officers, Pharmaceutical Officers, Medical Technology Officers, Medical Officers, Computer Officers, Veterinary Officers, Facilities Officers, or Industrial Officers) whose ranks are upgraded by the enforcement of this Rule shall remain in effect until December 31, 2027; however, from January 1, 2028, the corresponding authorized quota shall be deemed to be the authorized quota of 3 positions specified in Annex 3-2 (3 Administrative Assistants, Food Hygiene Assistants, Pharmaceutical Assistants, Medical Technology Assistants, Computer Assistants, Facilities Assistants, Industrial Assistants, or Veterinary Assistants). <Amended Mar. 24, 2026>

rows.text_en: Article 5 (Transitional Measures Concerning Open Positions)  Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 31, positions excluded from open positions shall be deemed to be positions eligible for appointment as fixed-term public officials until the day before the expiration of the term of service of the fixed-term public official currently holding the position or the day before a vacancy occurs in the position due to dismissal, etc.
